wiki.art.bartenders.charles-schumann.car: Munich since the 70s. Schumann's Bar 1982 — Germany's first serious cocktail bar. Influenced the entire later Germanic generation. Hugo Boss campaign model (70s-80s, known for his elegance).
wiki.art.bartenders.charles-schumann.sig: Schumann's signature menus. Style: elegant Bavarian bartender, classical conservatism, German precision.
wiki.art.bartenders.charles-schumann.tip: Schumann's on Maximilianstrasse (Munich) is must-visit if in Bavaria. 'American Bar' (1991) is a fundamental German/English text on classic cocktails.
wiki.art.bartenders.charles-schumann.sou: Schumann, American Bar (1991). Schumann, Tropical Bar (1995). Schumann's archive.
wiki.art.bartenders.kapri-robinson.title: Kapri Robinson
wiki.art.bartenders.kapri-robinson.descr: Kapri Robinson, American bartender, leading voice of Black bartending. Director of Hospitality at Allegory (DC). Co-founder of Chocolate City's Bartending Education for Black community. Speed Rack alumna.
wiki.art.bartenders.kapri-robinson.caree: Washington DC. Allegory (Eaton Hotel). Speed Rack alumna. Industry activism for racial diversification. Bartending education speaker.
wiki.art.bartenders.kapri-robinson.signa: Allegory signature cocktails. Storytelling-driven menus. Style: narrative cocktails about Black history.
wiki.art.bartenders.kapri-robinson.tips: Allegory in Eaton Hotel (DC) — themed 'Ruby Bridges and the integration of New Orleans schools'. Deep elegant storytelling.
wiki.art.bartenders.kapri-robinson.sourc: Allegory archive. PUNCH — Black bartending. Speed Rack.
wiki.art.bartenders.shingo-gokan.title: Shingo Gokan
wiki.art.bartenders.shingo-gokan.descrip: Shingo Gokan (b. 1983), Japanese bartender with bars in Shanghai, Tokyo and New York. Founder of SG Group: Speak Low (Shanghai), Sober Company (Shanghai), The SG Club (Tokyo), The Bar Benfiddich. Multiple World's Best Bar awards.
wiki.art.bartenders.shingo-gokan.career: Born in Japan. Worked at Angel's Share (NYC, Asian cocktail specialist). Speak Low (Shanghai 2014) — World's #3 in 2018. Sober Company (Shanghai 2017). The SG Club (Tokyo 2018). International expansion.
wiki.art.bartenders.shingo-gokan.signatu: Speak Low cocktails (Asian-inspired classic). Sober Company high-low concept. Style: Japanese precision + Asian flavours + multi-floor speakeasy concept.
wiki.art.bartenders.shingo-gokan.tips: Speak Low in Shanghai (Fuxing Road) — 4 floors with distinct concepts. Sober Company in Bund Shanghai — café/bar/restaurant combo. SG Club Tokyo.
wiki.art.bartenders.shingo-gokan.sources: SG Group archive. World's 50 Best. PUNCH — Asian bartending.
wiki.art.bartenders.hidetsugu-ueno.title: Hidetsugu Ueno
wiki.art.bartenders.hidetsugu-ueno.descr: Hidetsugu Ueno (b. 1968), legendary Japanese bartender, owner of Bar High Five (Tokyo, 2008). Master of hand-carved ice and Hard Shake (with Kazuo Uyeda). Bar High Five is World's Best Bar regular.
wiki.art.bartenders.hidetsugu-ueno.caree: Tokyo. Worked at Star Bar (Ginza) with Hisashi Kishi 1995-2008. Bar High Five 2008 (Ginza) — own bar. Hand-carved ice and impeccable service are his hallmark. No website or online reservations — walk-in only.
wiki.art.bartenders.hidetsugu-ueno.signa: Artisanal hand-carved ice spheres (5 minutes per sphere). Hard Shake (Uyeda's evolved technique). Style: Japanese precision, perfect classic cocktails, silent ritual.
wiki.art.bartenders.hidetsugu-ueno.tips: Bar High Five (Tokyo): only 7 bar seats, arrive early. No reservations, walk-in only. Bartender Ueno hand-carves each ice sphere in front of the client. Drink at Ueno's pace, not yours.
wiki.art.bartenders.hidetsugu-ueno.sourc: Ueno interviews in Imbibe Magazine. Bar High Five archive. Difford's Guide — Japanese bartending.
wiki.art.bartenders.kazuo-uyeda.title: Kazuo Uyeda
wiki.art.bartenders.kazuo-uyeda.descript: Kazuo Uyeda (b. 1944), Japanese bartender, father of the Hard Shake (specific shaking technique). Owner of Tender Bar (Tokyo, 1997). Inventor of the Japanese precision cocktail style. Author 'Cocktail Technique' (Tender Bar manual).
wiki.art.bartenders.kazuo-uyeda.career: Tokyo since the 70s. Tender Bar (Ginza) 1997 — his definitive bar. Hard Shake codified in the 80s — three-dimensional shaking with specific angle to produce unique creamy texture. Successor: Ueno (his disciple).
wiki.art.bartenders.kazuo-uyeda.signatur: Hard Shake. Tender Bar signature classics. Style: absolute Japanese precision, no decoration, small ritual.
wiki.art.bartenders.kazuo-uyeda.tips: Tender Bar Tokyo (Ginza) is hard to reserve, walk-in rare but possible. Hard Shake requires months of practice — elbow angle is critical. Read Cocktail Technique for details.
wiki.art.bartenders.kazuo-uyeda.sources: Uyeda, Cocktail Technique (Tender Bar manual). Difford's Guide — Hard Shake. Imbibe Magazine.
wiki.art.bartenders.kenta-goto.title: Kenta Goto
wiki.art.bartenders.kenta-goto.descripti: Kenta Goto, Japanese bartender based in NYC. After training in Tokyo and working at Pegu Club under Audrey Saunders, opened Bar Goto on the Lower East Side (2015), exponent of 'omotenashi' (Japanese hospitality) applied to American cocktails.
wiki.art.bartenders.kenta-goto.career: Tokyo: Kahala Salon. NYC: Pegu Club (2007), head bartender. Opened Bar Goto in 2015, Bar Goto Niban in 2020. James Beard Foundation Best American Bartender nominee.
wiki.art.bartenders.kenta-goto.signature: Sakura Martini (gin + sake + maraschino + sakura). Far East Side (Japanese whisky + cinnamon + lemon). Bar Goto Highball perfectionist (Japanese hard-shake technique).
wiki.art.bartenders.kenta-goto.tips: Bar Goto on Eldridge Street — small, no reservations, intimate. Pair karaage chicken with the Highball.
wiki.art.bartenders.kenta-goto.sources: James Beard Foundation. Punch Drink — Kenta Goto profile. Bar Goto NYC website.
wiki.art.bartenders.yutaka-yamamoto.desc: Yutaka Yamamoto, Japanese bartender at the Park Hyatt Tokyo, exponent of Japanese cocktail style: meditative precision, hand-carved ice and hard-shake technique. Direct disciple of the Kazuo Uyeda school.
wiki.art.bartenders.yutaka-yamamoto.care: Training in Tokyo. Park Hyatt Tokyo New York Bar — the bar from 'Lost in Translation'. International ambassador of Japanese bartending. Workshops in Europe and US.
wiki.art.bartenders.yutaka-yamamoto.sign: Tokyo Highball (Suntory whisky + soda + perfect technique). Yuzu cocktails with local ingredients. Hand-carved diamond ice.
wiki.art.bartenders.yutaka-yamamoto.tips: If you visit Tokyo, book the New York Bar at sunset. Watch the bartender's ritual — every gesture counts. Order Hibiki with the Highball.
wiki.art.bartenders.yutaka-yamamoto.sour: Park Hyatt Tokyo. Imbibe Magazine — Japanese bartending. Uyeda, Cocktail Technique.
wiki.art.bartenders.giuseppe-cipriani.de: Giuseppe Cipriani Sr. (1900-1980), founder of Venice's Harry's Bar in 1931. Inventor of the Bellini (1948) and the Carpaccio (1950). His bar drew Hemingway, Truman Capote, Onassis. The Cipriani family still operates Harry's today.
wiki.art.bartenders.giuseppe-cipriani.ca: Started as waiter at Venice's Hotel Europa. Met Harry Pickering (American) who lent him money. In gratitude named the bar after him (1931). Four Cipriani generations have kept the business going.
wiki.art.bartenders.giuseppe-cipriani.si: Bellini (Prosecco + white peach purée, 1948). Carpaccio (1950). Harry's Bar Martini (own version). 20th-century Italian bar atmosphere.
wiki.art.bartenders.giuseppe-cipriani.ti: Harry's Bar Venice (Calle Vallaresso 1323) still operating. Book ahead. Original Bellini only in white-peach season (summer).
wiki.art.bartenders.giuseppe-cipriani.so: Cipriani family archive. Hemingway, Across the River and into the Trees (1950). Time Magazine — Harry's Bar profile.
wiki.art.bartenders.federico-doria.title: Federico Doria
wiki.art.bartenders.federico-doria.descr: Federico Doria, Italian bartender, reference for classic and contemporary Italian cocktail. Linked to Milan's Carbonari Bar heritage, international ambassador of Amaro and Aperitivo. Educator in cocktail schools.
wiki.art.bartenders.federico-doria.caree: Classic Italian training. Bartender in Milan, Rome bars. Ambassador for Campari and Amaro Montenegro. Educator at ICTS Academy (Italy) and international workshops.
wiki.art.bartenders.federico-doria.signa: Perfectionist Negroni Sbagliato. Americano alla romana. Innovations with contemporary Italian Amaro. Elegant Italian style without showiness.
wiki.art.bartenders.federico-doria.tips: To understand Negroni and Aperitivo, follow his tutorials and interviews. 1:1:1 Negroni is just the start — explore Italian regional variants.
wiki.art.bartenders.federico-doria.sourc: Italian bartending magazines. Campari Academy. Negroni Week documentation.
wiki.art.bartenders.ada-russell.title: Ada Russell
wiki.art.bartenders.ada-russell.descript: Ada Russell, pioneer bartender of Victorian London. One of the first women documented working professionally behind English bars in the late 19th century, before Ada Coleman. Key figure to reclaim early female cocktail history.
wiki.art.bartenders.ada-russell.career: Worked in West End pubs and hotels in 1880s-90s. Few biographical details survive (typical of women in the trade then). Documented in guild records.
wiki.art.bartenders.ada-russell.signatur: Gin and sherry cocktails of the Victorian era. Hot punches for English gentry. No signed recipe documented (attribution defaulted to men).
wiki.art.bartenders.ada-russell.tips: Her story was rediscovered in the 2010s with the female bartending revisionist wave. Read Cocktails: A Global History (Coxe & Stuart) for context.
wiki.art.bartenders.ada-russell.sources: UKBG archives. Coxe & Stuart, Cocktails: A Global History. Female bartending history.
wiki.art.bartenders.amanda-washington.de: Amanda Washington, African-American bartender, reference figure for diversity in contemporary bartending. Active in NYC and Atlanta, co-founder of initiatives for visibility of POC bartenders. Educator in inclusive cocktail schools.
wiki.art.bartenders.amanda-washington.ca: Trained in Atlanta. Worked at Brooklyn and Manhattan bars. Co-leader of programs like 'Cocktails for a Cause' funding scholarships for minority bartenders. Regular speaker at Bar Convent and Tales of the Cocktail.
wiki.art.bartenders.amanda-washington.si: Cocktails with African-American Southern tradition (sweet tea, peach, bourbon, mint). Highballs with bourbon from small Black-owned Kentucky distilleries.
wiki.art.bartenders.amanda-washington.ti: Follow her work on social media and events. The cocktail industry has complex racial history; her context is essential to understand today's sector.
wiki.art.bartenders.amanda-washington.so: Tales of the Cocktail Foundation diversity reports. Black Bartender Association. Imbibe Magazine — POC bartender profiles.
wiki.art.bartenders.leo-robitschek.title: Leo Robitschek
wiki.art.bartenders.leo-robitschek.descr: Leo Robitschek (1981-), Austrian-American bartender. Bar director at NoMad Hotel and Eleven Madison Park (Will Guidara, Daniel Humm). James Beard Best American Bartender 2014. Designer of cocktail programs paired with fine-dining cuisine.
wiki.art.bartenders.leo-robitschek.caree: NoMad NYC from 2012, EMP cocktail program. Bar director until NoMad NYC closed in 2020. Collaborated on LA and Las Vegas openings. Author of The NoMad Cocktail Book (2019).
wiki.art.bartenders.leo-robitschek.signa: Cocktails for the Three Course Menu — pairing cocktails with tasting plates. Sophisticated Old-Fashioned riffs. Philosophy of 'cocktail as a course'.
wiki.art.bartenders.leo-robitschek.tips: The NoMad Cocktail Book (2019) has 300+ modern recipes with advanced techniques. Essential to understand hotel-restaurant bar programs at the highest level.
wiki.art.bartenders.leo-robitschek.sourc: Robitschek, The NoMad Cocktail Book (2019). James Beard Foundation. Imbibe Magazine.
wiki.art.bartenders.thomas-aske.title: Thomas Aske
wiki.art.bartenders.thomas-aske.descript: Thomas Aske, British bartender, co-founder of Fluid Movement Ltd. and international consultant. Creator of the 'liquid academy' approach integrating bar science and technique. Pioneer of modern cocktail consulting in Europe.
wiki.art.bartenders.thomas-aske.career: Worked in London bars in the 2000s. Co-founded Fluid Movement with Tristan Stephenson around 2009. Bar consultancy for hotels and brands worldwide. Co-author of books with Stephenson.
wiki.art.bartenders.thomas-aske.signatur: Cocktails with scientific technique (clarification, fat-wash, foams). Consultancy programs systematising menu and training. The bar as a trade academy.
wiki.art.bartenders.thomas-aske.tips: If you're interested in bar consulting and bar program design, his collaborations with Stephenson (Curious Bartender books) are reference.
wiki.art.bartenders.thomas-aske.sources: Stephenson & Aske, The Curious Bartender's Whiskey Road Trip. Fluid Movement website. Imbibe Magazine.
wiki.art.bartenders.tristan-stephenson.d: Tristan Stephenson, British bartender, writer and consultant. Co-founder with Aske of Fluid Movement and Black Rock (London whisky bar). Prolific author — The Curious Bartender series (8+ books). Educator and communicator of technical bartending.
wiki.art.bartenders.tristan-stephenson.c: Originally sommelier. London bartender from 2009. Black Rock opened 2015 (sculpted-oak whisky bar). Over 8 published books, including The Curious Bartender's Whiskey Road Trip and The Curious Bartender Volume I.
wiki.art.bartenders.tristan-stephenson.s: Old Fashioneds with modern techniques (sous-vide infusions, clarification). Whisky cocktails (Black Rock). Didactic style teaching science + tradition.
wiki.art.bartenders.tristan-stephenson.t: The Curious Bartender Vol. I (2013) is perfect intro to technical bartending. Visit Black Rock in Shoreditch — conceptual bar with sculpted-oak counter.
wiki.art.bartenders.tristan-stephenson.s: Stephenson, The Curious Bartender (2013+). Black Rock website. Class Magazine UK.
wiki.art.bartenders.iain-griffiths.title: Iain Griffiths
wiki.art.bartenders.iain-griffiths.descr: Iain Griffiths, Australian-British bartender, co-founder with Ryan Chetiyawardana of Dandelyan (Mondrian London) and later Cub. Pioneer of sustainable bartending — Cub was the world's first no-waste bar. Radical ecological philosophy.
wiki.art.bartenders.iain-griffiths.caree: Worked in Sydney and London. Dandelyan (2014-2018) — World's 50 Best Bar #1 in 2018. Cub (2017) — world's first 'no waste' bar. Closed Cub 2020, focused on sustainability consulting.
wiki.art.bartenders.iain-griffiths.signa: Cocktails with ingredient upcycling (peel scraps, root tops, second-distillations). In-house fermentations. Circular-economy cocktail philosophy.
wiki.art.bartenders.iain-griffiths.tips: Cub closed but its philosophy keeps inspiring. Follow his Bar Convent talks — sustainability is no longer optional in the industry.
wiki.art.bartenders.iain-griffiths.sourc: Cub London archive. World's 50 Best Bars 2018. The Guardian — sustainable cocktails.
wiki.art.bartenders.remy-savage.title: Rémy Savage
wiki.art.bartenders.remy-savage.descript: Rémy Savage, French-British bartender, head bartender of Little Red Door (Paris) and later A Bar With Shapes For A Name (London). World's 50 Best Bars top 10 multiple years. Conceptual style with thematic menus based on Bauhaus aesthetics.
wiki.art.bartenders.remy-savage.career: Paris: Le Coq, Little Red Door. London: A Bar With Shapes For A Name from 2021. Menus inspired by Kandinsky, Theo Van Doesburg, Bauhaus principles. Designed as art exhibitions.
wiki.art.bartenders.remy-savage.signatur: Cocktails with visual aesthetic narrative. Ephemeral menus each year (artist-of-the-year format). Unexpected combinations justified by visual and harmonic composition.
wiki.art.bartenders.remy-savage.tips: If you visit London, A Bar With Shapes For A Name (Shoreditch) is conceptual experience. Book ahead. Order the tasting menu.
wiki.art.bartenders.remy-savage.sources: World's 50 Best Bars 2022-2024. Imbibe Magazine — Rémy Savage profile. Difford's Guide.
wiki.art.bartenders.phil-ward.title: Phil Ward
wiki.art.bartenders.phil-ward.descriptio: Phil Ward, American bartender, key figure of the agave renaissance in NYC. Head bartender of Death & Co (2006-2010) and founder of Mayahuel — world's first 100% mezcal-and-tequila-dedicated bar (NYC 2009). Innovator of cocktails with Mexican spirits.
wiki.art.bartenders.phil-ward.career: Pegu Club under Audrey Saunders. Death & Co (2006 opening). Mayahuel (2009-2017). Later Dutch Kills, Long Island Bar Brooklyn. Multiple Tales of the Cocktail recognitions.
wiki.art.bartenders.phil-ward.signature: Oaxaca Old Fashioned (mezcal + reposado tequila, 2007). Final Ward (rye + maraschino + Green Chartreuse + lemon, Last Word variant). Mayahuel program — complete agave education.
wiki.art.bartenders.phil-ward.tips: Oaxaca Old Fashioned is already modern classic — combines tequila sweetness with mezcal smoke. Visit Mayahuel-style bars for agave learning.
wiki.art.bartenders.phil-ward.sources: Death & Co Modern Classic Cocktails (2014). Punch Drink — Phil Ward profile. Tales of the Cocktail.
wiki.art.bartenders.jeffrey-morgenthaler: Jeffrey Morgenthaler (1973-), American bartender at Clyde Common (Portland, Oregon). Famous for his blog jeffreymorgenthaler.com (online technique reference), for reinventing the Amaretto Sour, and for writing The Bar Book (2014) on fundamental technique. Educator of classic technique.

Originally graphic designer, self-taught bartender. Clyde Common from 2009, head bartender until bar's 2020 closure. Pacific Standard (Portland) currently. His blog since 2004 has been technical reference for a generation.
Reinvented Amaretto Sour (with overproof bourbon + egg white). Barrel-aged Negroni at scale. Perfect shake technique, correct jigger, optimal simple syrup.
The Bar Book (2014) is essential technical manual — explains WHY everything is done, not just how. His blog has 20-year archive.
Morgenthaler, The Bar Book (2014). Morgenthaler, Drinking Distilled (2018). jeffreymorgenthaler.com.
wiki.art.bartenders.willy-shine.title: Willy Shine
wiki.art.bartenders.willy-shine.descript: Willy Shine, American bartender, co-founder of The Tippling Bros. (with Aisha Sharpe), international bar program consultancy. Historic ambassador of modern cocktail in Las Vegas and NYC. Educator at BarSmarts.
wiki.art.bartenders.willy-shine.career: Started in NYC in the 1990s. Co-founded Tippling Bros. in 2009. Consultancy for Wynn Las Vegas, MGM, luxury hotels. BarSmarts ambassador (Pernod Ricard training program).
wiki.art.bartenders.willy-shine.signatur: Bar program development for luxury hotels. Cocktails with local products per destination (terroir cocktail philosophy). Training of bartender teams at international hotels.
wiki.art.bartenders.willy-shine.tips: Tippling Bros. have done cocktail programs at 200+ properties worldwide. To understand consulting business, follow their publications and interviews.
wiki.art.bartenders.willy-shine.sources: Tippling Bros. website. BarSmarts (Pernod Ricard). Cheers Magazine — Willy Shine profile.
wiki.art.bartenders.chuck-taggart.title: Chuck Taggart
wiki.art.bartenders.chuck-taggart.descri: Chuck Taggart, American bartender and historian based in New Orleans, author of The Original Sazerac (1937 documentation) and curator of Gumbo Pages — New Orleans cocktail online resource since 1995. Revindicator of Sazerac and Vieux Carré as intangible heritage.
wiki.art.bartenders.chuck-taggart.career: Originally journalist. Amateur bartender with encyclopedic expertise in New Orleans cocktails. His Gumbopages.com has been reference since mid-1990s. Frequent contributor to cultural publications.
wiki.art.bartenders.chuck-taggart.signat: Purist Sazerac (rye + Peychaud bitter + absinthe wash + lemon peel). Vieux Carré (Walter Bergeron 1938). Brandy Crusta. Crescent City cocktails without modern innovation.
wiki.art.bartenders.chuck-taggart.tips: Visit gumbopages.com for the most exhaustive New Orleans cocktail documentation. If you go to NO, find the Sazerac House (museum + bar) and French Quarter bars.
wiki.art.bartenders.chuck-taggart.source: Gumbopages.com. Wondrich, Imbibe!. Sazerac House New Orleans archive.
wiki.art.bartenders.natasha-david.title: Natasha David
wiki.art.bartenders.natasha-david.descri: Natasha David, American bartender of Austrian origin. Co-founder of Nitecap (NYC, 2014-2020) with Jeremy Oertel. Known for her elegant style, cocktail-pairing program with food, and mentorship work for women in the industry.
wiki.art.bartenders.natasha-david.career: Started at Mayahuel (Phil Ward). Co-founded Nitecap on Lower East Side NYC 2014. Closed due to COVID 2020. Later consulting, brand ambassadorship and educator. Mentor at LUPEC program.
wiki.art.bartenders.natasha-david.signat: Easy-drinking but technically sophisticated cocktails. Sour-style with citrus and spices. Cocktail-food pairing in Nitecap program. Approachable elegance.
wiki.art.bartenders.natasha-david.tips: Follow her ambassador and educator work. Nitecap philosophy (welcoming bar, not pretentious, technically excellent) remains a model.
wiki.art.bartenders.natasha-david.source: Punch Drink — Natasha David profile. Imbibe Magazine. LUPEC.
wiki.art.bartenders.sother-teague.title: Sother Teague
wiki.art.bartenders.sother-teague.descri: Sother Teague, American bartender, beverage director of Amor y Amargo (NYC, Ravi DeRossi) — world's first bar 100% dedicated to amaro. Educator and author of I'm Just Here for the Drinks (2018). Radio voice 'The Speakeasy' podcast.
wiki.art.bartenders.sother-teague.career: Originally culinary chef, transitioned to NYC bartending. Amor y Amargo since 2011 opening. Bar program 100% bitter-amaro. Co-host of The Speakeasy podcast with Damon Boelte.
wiki.art.bartenders.sother-teague.signat: Cocktails with amaro as main ingredient (not modifier). Sherry + amaro pairings. Educational program on historic bitters.
wiki.art.bartenders.sother-teague.tips: Visit Amor y Amargo (East Village) — every cocktail has amaro. His book I'm Just Here for the Drinks (2018) explains the amaro genre in depth.
wiki.art.bartenders.sother-teague.source: Teague, I'm Just Here for the Drinks (2018). The Speakeasy podcast. Amor y Amargo NYC.
wiki.art.bartenders.ali-bullock.title: Ali Bullock
wiki.art.bartenders.ali-bullock.descript: Ali Bullock, British bartender, historic bar manager of Coupette (London) — bar dedicated to Calvados and contemporary French cocktail. World's 50 Best Bars top 30. International ambassador of Calvados as cocktail spirit.
wiki.art.bartenders.ali-bullock.career: Worked in London bars. Bar manager of Coupette since its 2017 opening (Bethnal Green). Educator at French spirits events. Cocktails of the season with artisanal French producers.
wiki.art.bartenders.ali-bullock.signatur: Mr. Coupette — signature cocktail with infused Calvados. Vermouth-based aperitifs. Cocktails honoring Norman and Breton tradition.
wiki.art.bartenders.ali-bullock.tips: Visit Coupette (Bethnal Green Road, London) — French bistro atmosphere. Menu rotates with Norman agricultural season. Order any Calvados cocktail.
wiki.art.bartenders.ali-bullock.sources: Coupette London. World's 50 Best Bars. Imbibe Magazine — Coupette profile.
wiki.art.bartenders.claudia-kang.title: Claudia Kang
wiki.art.bartenders.claudia-kang.descrip: Claudia Kang, Korean-American bartender, head bartender at NYC and Seoul bars. Pioneer of cocktails with makgeolli (Korean rice wine), soju and Asian ingredients in contemporary Western cocktail program. Co-leader of Asian Bartender Network.
wiki.art.bartenders.claudia-kang.career: Trained in NYC. Bartender at Bar Goto and later Atomix Korean fine dining (NYC). Later programs in Seoul. Asian spirits ambassador at global bartender events.
wiki.art.bartenders.claudia-kang.signatu: Cocktails with sparkling makgeolli. Soju-infused vermouth. Yuzu-tea Highball. Cocktails connecting Korean tradition with Western technique.
wiki.art.bartenders.claudia-kang.tips: If you visit Seoul, find bars with contemporary Korean program (Charles H, Le Chamber). If in NYC, Atomix bar is essential. Order makgeolli cocktail to understand.
wiki.art.bartenders.claudia-kang.sources: Atomix NYC. Asian Bartender Network. Eater NY — Asian cocktail bars profile.
wiki.art.bartenders.daniel-shoemaker.des: Daniel Shoemaker, American bartender, founder of Teardrop Lounge (Portland, Oregon) — Pacific Northwest's first craft cocktail bar (2007). Pioneer of farm-to-bar philosophy with local Oregon producers. Mentor of Jeffrey Morgenthaler and Lance Mayhew.
wiki.art.bartenders.daniel-shoemaker.car: Originally sommelier, transitioned to bartending in 2000s. Opened Teardrop Lounge in 2007 — one of the first craft bars outside NYC/SF. Oregon products ambassador (Aviation gin, Clear Creek spirits).
wiki.art.bartenders.daniel-shoemaker.sig: Cocktails with Oregon ingredients (lavender, blackberry, marionberry, hazelnut). Tom Collins Northwest. Rotating program based on local producer markets.
wiki.art.bartenders.daniel-shoemaker.tip: Visit Teardrop Lounge in Portland — still operating. Cocktail program has maintained excellence 15+ years. Order seasonal cocktail with local products.
wiki.art.bartenders.daniel-shoemaker.sou: Teardrop Lounge Portland. Imbibe Magazine — Portland craft scene. Punch Drink.
American Bar at the Savoy Hotel — London's oldest continuously operating bar (1893). Home of Ada Coleman (1903-1925), Harry Craddock (1925-1939) and The Savoy Cocktail Book (1930). Temple of classic British cocktailing.

Opened 1893 when the Savoy became one of the world's first modern hotels. Ada Coleman head bartender 1903-1925, first woman in the role. Harry Craddock succeeded her and published The Savoy Cocktail Book (1930). Refurbished 2010.
Hanky Panky (Ada Coleman, 1903). White Lady (Craddock). Corpse Reviver #2 (Craddock). Iconic Vespers. Original Art Deco atmosphere preserved.
Book weeks ahead. Formal dress code. Order the Hanky Panky or any Craddock classic. Live jazz piano every night.
Savoy Hotel archive. Craddock, The Savoy Cocktail Book (1930). Wondrich, Imbibe!. World's 50 Best Bars.
wiki.art.bars.dukes-bar-london.title: Dukes Bar
wiki.art.bars.dukes-bar-london.descripti: Dukes Bar at Dukes Hotel (Mayfair) — world's most legendary Martini bar, where Alessandro Palazzi (head bartender since 1990s) serves perfect tableside Martinis with theatrical stirring. Inspired Fleming/Bond's 'shaken not stirred'.
wiki.art.bars.dukes-bar-london.history: Hotel since 1908, bar consolidated in 1960s. Salvatore Calabrese was head bartender in 1980s before moving. Alessandro Palazzi since 1990s — legendary Martini figure. Fleming was a regular.
wiki.art.bars.dukes-bar-london.signature: Vesper Martini (gin + vodka + Lillet Blanc, honoring Fleming). Dukes Martini served tableside with presentation. Negroni Sbagliato. Traditional English club atmosphere.
wiki.art.bars.dukes-bar-london.tips: Reservation essential — bar is small. Ask Palazzi for the Vesper for full experience. Expensive but unique cocktail. Hyped but deserved.
wiki.art.bars.dukes-bar-london.sources: Dukes Hotel website. Palazzi, Dukes Hotel Cocktail Book. 50 Best Bars.
wiki.art.bars.connaught-bar-london.title: Connaught Bar
wiki.art.bars.connaught-bar-london.descr: Connaught Bar at Connaught Hotel (Mayfair) — #1 World's 50 Best Bars 2020, 2021. Under head bartender Ago Perrone (Italian) since 2008. Temple of elegance with Martini cart, tableside cocktail and Belle Époque atmosphere.
wiki.art.bars.connaught-bar-london.histo: Hotel since 1815. Bar refurbished by David Collins 2008. Ago Perrone arrived as head bartender 2008. Successive world awards from 2010. Evolving cocktail program each year.
wiki.art.bars.connaught-bar-london.signa: Connaught Martini (gin + selected vermouth, tableside cart). Vieux Rectangle. Daiquiri Florida (with Casamigos Blanco). 'Agnostic' series cocktails (unpredictable combinations).
wiki.art.bars.connaught-bar-london.tips: Reserve months ahead. Formal dress code. Order Connaught Martini with cart (30-min experience). Lobby champagne lounge.
wiki.art.bars.connaught-bar-london.sourc: Connaught Hotel website. 50 Best Bars 2020, 2021. Perrone interviews. Imbibe Magazine.
wiki.art.bars.scarfes-london.title: Scarfes Bar
wiki.art.bars.scarfes-london.description: Scarfes Bar at Rosewood London — boutique hotel bar with cartoon decor signed by Gerald Scarfe (Sunday Times cartoonist). Literary-political atmosphere with library and fireplace, head bartender Yann Bouvignies. World's 50 Best Bars top 30.
wiki.art.bars.scarfes-london.history: Opened 2013 when Rosewood Hotels took over the old Pearl Assurance Building. Decor by architect Tony Chi with original Scarfe cartoons. Bar program developed by Bouvignies since 2018.
wiki.art.bars.scarfes-london.signature: Cocktails inspired by political biographies. Negroni with own bitters. Sunday Times themed series. Live jazz Friday and Saturday.
wiki.art.bars.scarfes-london.tips: Book weekends. Relaxed but elegant atmosphere. Order the themed cocktail flight (3 narrative cocktails).
wiki.art.bars.scarfes-london.sources: Rosewood London. 50 Best Bars. Imbibe Magazine.
wiki.art.bars.lyaness-london.title: Lyaness
wiki.art.bars.lyaness-london.description: Lyaness — Ryan Chetiyawardana's second bar at Sea Containers (Southbank), opened 2020 after Dandelyan closed. Cocktail program reinvented with themed book changing yearly (Spirit of London, North Sea…). World's 50 Best Bars top 10.
wiki.art.bars.lyaness-london.history: Opened December 2019. Replaced award-winning Dandelyan. Each year a new themed book developed by Chetiyawardana and team. Evolving concept, not static menu.
wiki.art.bars.lyaness-london.signature: Spirit of London cocktail series (2021). Sustainable focus inherited from Dandelyan. Cocktails with hyperlocal fermented ingredients.
wiki.art.bars.lyaness-london.tips: Reservation essential. Ask about current book and order 3-cocktail flight. Panoramic Thames view from Sea Containers.
wiki.art.bars.lyaness-london.sources: Lyaness website. Chetiyawardana interviews. 50 Best Bars.
wiki.art.bars.swift-london.title: Swift
wiki.art.bars.swift-london.description: Swift — two-level Soho bar (upstairs for light cocktails, downstairs dark room for stronger whisky-focused drinks). Co-founded by Bobby Hiddleston and Mia Johansson (ex-American Bar Savoy and Connaught). World's 50 Best Bars top 20.
wiki.art.bars.swift-london.history: Opened 2016 by Hiddleston and Johansson. 'Two bars in one' concept — upstairs for pre-dinner, downstairs for after. Downstairs whisky bar has 250+ labels.
wiki.art.bars.swift-london.signature: Perfected Espresso Martini. Mia's Manhattan. Saint-Germain spritz. Old Fashioned variants program downstairs.
wiki.art.bars.swift-london.tips: Reserve especially downstairs. Order cheese or truffle board with cocktail. No reservations upstairs — walk-in.
wiki.art.bars.swift-london.sources: Swift London. 50 Best Bars. Punch Drink — Hiddleston profile.
wiki.art.bars.tayer-elementary-london.de: Tayer (cocktail bar) + Elementary (casual café-cocktail) — dual concept by Alex Kratena and Monica Berg in Old Street, Shoreditch. World's 50 Best Bars top 3. Tayer does haute couture cocktail, Elementary accessible day cocktails.
wiki.art.bars.tayer-elementary-london.hi: Opened 2019 by Berg and Kratena (ex-Artesian, world-renowned). Tayer is technical tasting bar; Elementary is neighborhood café + cocktail. Extreme sustainability from day one.
wiki.art.bars.tayer-elementary-london.si: Tayer: cocktails with scientific technique and tasting. Elementary: signature Negroni, Espresso Martini, specialty coffee. Zero waste.
wiki.art.bars.tayer-elementary-london.ti: Reservation essential for Tayer. Walk-in Elementary. Order tasting flight at Tayer (4-6 cocktails with plates).
wiki.art.bars.tayer-elementary-london.so: Tayer Elementary website. 50 Best Bars 2022 #3. Imbibe — Kratena & Berg.
wiki.art.bars.the-savoy-thames-foyer.des: Thames Foyer at the Savoy Hotel — afternoon tea and day cocktail room of the iconic hotel. Distinct from the American Bar (which is night-only). Classic British cocktails with Champagne focus in Edwardian atmosphere.
wiki.art.bars.the-savoy-thames-foyer.his: Space renovated in 2010 with the general Savoy refurbishment. Day cocktail program focusing on Champagne and G&Ts. Permanent live pianist.
wiki.art.bars.the-savoy-thames-foyer.sig: Savoy Champagne Cocktail. G&T flights with British gins. Pimm's Cup. High Tea Sandwich pairings.
wiki.art.bars.the-savoy-thames-foyer.tip: Ideal for afternoon tea with cocktail. Reserve ahead. Smart casual dress code during day.
wiki.art.bars.the-savoy-thames-foyer.sou: Savoy Hotel website. Savoy Cocktail Book modern editions.
wiki.art.bars.milk-honey-london.title: Milk & Honey
wiki.art.bars.milk-honey-london.descript: Milk & Honey London (closed 2019) — Soho speakeasy founded by Jonathan Downey and Sasha Petraske. Replica of the NYC original. Key influence in modern London cocktail revival (2002-2019).
wiki.art.bars.milk-honey-london.history: Opened 2002, closed 2019. Traditional rules (no cell phones, no haggling). Membership by invitation early years. Brought NYC speakeasy to London. Closed for transformation.
wiki.art.bars.milk-honey-london.signatur: Penicillin (Sam Ross). Old Cuban (Audrey Saunders). Whiskey Smash (Petraske). Intimate bar atmosphere without pretension.
wiki.art.bars.milk-honey-london.tips: Closed, but legacy alive. Visit Attaboy NYC or The Everleigh Melbourne (Petraske descendants).
wiki.art.bars.milk-honey-london.sources: Milk & Honey archive. Imbibe — Petraske legacy.
wiki.art.bars.happiness-forgets-london.d: Happiness Forgets — basement bar in Hoxton Square, Shoreditch. Co-founded by Alastair Burgess. World's 50 Best Bars top 50 multiple years. Speakeasy atmosphere without pretension, simple but flawless cocktails.
wiki.art.bars.happiness-forgets-london.h: Opened 2010 by Burgess. 'Less is more' philosophy — short menu of perfected classics. No online reservations, walk-in.
wiki.art.bars.happiness-forgets-london.s: Happy Old-Fashioned (variant with maraschino + bitter). Berkeley Square (gin + Lillet + grapefruit). Precise-technique Negroni.
wiki.art.bars.happiness-forgets-london.t: Arrive early (opens 5:30 PM). Small — limited capacity. Order any classic — Burgess is a precision fanatic.
wiki.art.bars.happiness-forgets-london.s: Happiness Forgets website. 50 Best Bars. Class Magazine UK.
wiki.art.bars.milk-honey-nyc.title: Milk & Honey (NYC)
wiki.art.bars.milk-honey-nyc.description: Milk & Honey NYC (closed 2013) — Sasha Petraske's original bar on Eldridge Street, Lower East Side. Opened 1999, considered pioneer of modern global cocktail revival. Philosophy: hospitality as ritual.
wiki.art.bars.milk-honey-nyc.history: Opened 1999. Moved 2013 to Park Avenue (Milk Room version). Closed permanently when Petraske died 2015. Modeled dozens of subsequent bars worldwide.
wiki.art.bars.milk-honey-nyc.signature: Penicillin (Sam Ross). Gold Rush (T.J. Siegal). Whiskey Smash. Strict house rules (no cell phones, no shouting).
wiki.art.bars.milk-honey-nyc.tips: Closed. Visit Attaboy (Eldridge 134, direct successor) or Dutch Kills Long Island City — Petraske heirs.
wiki.art.bars.milk-honey-nyc.sources: Petraske archive. Sasha Petraske: Honesty in a Glass (2017). NYT obituary.
wiki.art.bars.attaboy-nyc.title: Attaboy
wiki.art.bars.attaboy-nyc.description: Attaboy — no-menu bar on Eldridge Street, LES, direct successor to Milk & Honey. Opened 2013 by Sam Ross and Michael McIlroy (ex-Milk & Honey). Bespoke cocktails based on customer preference. Intimate subway speakeasy atmosphere.
wiki.art.bars.attaboy-nyc.history: Opened 2013 when Petraske moved. Ross and McIlroy kept the original space. Bespoke concept: bartender asks preference and creates cocktail on the spot. M&H house rules maintained.
wiki.art.bars.attaboy-nyc.signature: Penicillin (Sam Ross signature). Gold Rush. Customized cocktails — no written menu. Exposed brick bar atmosphere.
wiki.art.bars.attaboy-nyc.tips: No reservations, walk-in. Small capacity, wait can be long Friday/Saturday. Trust the bartender — say your favorite spirit and preferences.
wiki.art.bars.attaboy-nyc.sources: Attaboy NYC. Punch Drink — Sam Ross. 50 Best Bars.
wiki.art.bars.please-dont-tell-nyc.title: Please Don't Tell (PDT)
wiki.art.bars.please-dont-tell-nyc.descr: Please Don't Tell — mythic speakeasy in East Village with phone-booth entry through Crif Dogs. Opened 2007 by Jim Meehan. Pioneer of modern re-speakeasy. Very limited capacity.
wiki.art.bars.please-dont-tell-nyc.histo: Opened 2007 when Jim Meehan transformed the space. Entry through hot dog shop phone booth — unique concept. Meehan published The PDT Cocktail Book (2011) with all recipes. Still operating.
wiki.art.bars.please-dont-tell-nyc.signa: Benton's Old Fashioned (bacon fat-washed bourbon). Mezcal Mule. Jim Meehan-era cocktail menu. Underground atmosphere, max 35 people.
wiki.art.bars.please-dont-tell-nyc.tips: Reservation essential — phone line opens 3 PM daily for same night. Limited to 90 min. Order Benton's or any Meehan-era.
wiki.art.bars.please-dont-tell-nyc.sourc: Meehan, The PDT Cocktail Book (2011). PDT website. 50 Best Bars.
wiki.art.bars.employees-only-nyc.title: Employees Only
wiki.art.bars.employees-only-nyc.descrip: Employees Only — West Village bar opened 2004 by Igor Hadzismajlovic, Henry LaFargue and Dushan Zaric. Pioneer of modern cocktail bar focusing on five-star hospitality and robust signature drinks. Multiple international locations.
wiki.art.bars.employees-only-nyc.history: Opened 2004. Premium NYC concept. Later opened in Singapore, Hong Kong, Los Angeles. World's 50 Best Bars #1 in 2011. EO Cocktail Book published 2018.
wiki.art.bars.employees-only-nyc.signatu: Ginger Smash (gin + fresh ginger + honey). EO Manhattan. Mata Hari (cognac + chai). Authoritative cocktail program.
wiki.art.bars.employees-only-nyc.tips: Reserve ahead. Modern speakeasy atmosphere, not historic. Order signature cocktails from EO book. Quality Italian cuisine.
wiki.art.bars.employees-only-nyc.sources: Employees Only NYC. 50 Best Bars 2011 #1. EO Cocktail Book (2018).
wiki.art.bars.death-and-co-nyc.title: Death & Co
wiki.art.bars.death-and-co-nyc.descripti: Death & Co — East Village, opened 2006 by David Kaplan, Ravi DeRossi and Phil Ward. Temple of modern NYC cocktail. Originator of Oaxaca Old Fashioned. Multiple books published. Expansion to Denver, Los Angeles, Las Vegas.
wiki.art.bars.death-and-co-nyc.history: Opened 2006. Phil Ward head bartender until 2010 (then Mayahuel). Kaplan + Alex Day published Death & Co Cocktail Book (2014) — bestseller. Multiple locations today. From speakeasy to international brand.
wiki.art.bars.death-and-co-nyc.signature: Oaxaca Old Fashioned (Phil Ward). Final Ward. Naked & Famous. Quarterly rotating cocktail program. Bartender training academic program.
wiki.art.bars.death-and-co-nyc.tips: Reserve ahead. Program rotates — order off-menu if you want book classics. Also visit Denver and LA versions.
wiki.art.bars.death-and-co-nyc.sources: Death & Co Cocktail Book (2014). Death & Co Welcome Home (2021). 50 Best Bars.
wiki.art.bars.the-dead-rabbit-nyc.title: The Dead Rabbit
wiki.art.bars.the-dead-rabbit-nyc.descri: The Dead Rabbit — Irish bar in NYC Financial District, opened 2013 by Sean Muldoon and Jack McGarry (ex-Merchant Hotel Belfast). Reconstruction of 19th-century Irish pub. World's 50 Best Bars #1 in 2016. 3 floors with distinct programs.
wiki.art.bars.the-dead-rabbit-nyc.histor: Opened 2013. Named after notorious 19th-century NYC Irish gang. Three floors: Taproom (brewery + pub), Parlor (cocktail bar) and Occasional (private dining). 50 Best Bars #1 in 2016. The Dead Rabbit Drinks Manual (2015) and Mixology & Mayhem (2018).
wiki.art.bars.the-dead-rabbit-nyc.signat: Irish Goodbye (Muldoon). The Dead Rabbit punch. Exhaustive Irish whisky cocktails program. 200+ Irish whiskey labels.
wiki.art.bars.the-dead-rabbit-nyc.tips: Visit 3 floors in ascending order (beer → cocktails → tasting). Cocktail program rotates. Reserve Parlor.
wiki.art.bars.the-dead-rabbit-nyc.source: Dead Rabbit Drinks Manual (2015). 50 Best Bars 2016 #1. Mixology & Mayhem (2018).
wiki.art.bars.amor-y-amargo-nyc.title: Amor y Amargo
wiki.art.bars.amor-y-amargo-nyc.descript: Amor y Amargo — East Village, NYC, opened 2011 by Ravi DeRossi. World's first bar 100% dedicated to amaro (every cocktail has amaro or bitters as main ingredient). Beverage director Sother Teague.
wiki.art.bars.amor-y-amargo-nyc.history: Opened 2011. DeRossi conceptualized the world's first 'bitters bar'. Sother Teague directs since opening. Influenced dozens of amaro-focused bars worldwide.
wiki.art.bars.amor-y-amargo-nyc.signatur: Trinidad Sour (rye + Angostura + lemon + orgeat). Hanky Panky. Amaro-based Negronis. Educational cocktail flights on amaro families.
wiki.art.bars.amor-y-amargo-nyc.tips: If you want to understand amaro, this is the bar. Order tasting flight. Walk-in, small. Pair with sister bar Mother's Ruin.
wiki.art.bars.amor-y-amargo-nyc.sources: Teague, I'm Just Here for the Drinks (2018). Amor y Amargo NYC. Imbibe.
wiki.art.bars.dante-nyc.title: Dante
wiki.art.bars.dante-nyc.description: Dante — historic Greenwich Village café-bar revamped in 2015 by Linden Pride and Naren Young. World's 50 Best Bars #1 in 2019. Known for its Negroni program (over 12 variants) and relaxed Italian atmosphere.
wiki.art.bars.dante-nyc.history: Café since 1915, known by Patti Smith, Bob Dylan, JFK Jr. Revamped 2015 keeping original decor. World's 50 Best Bars #1 in 2019. Sister Dante West Village (larger) opened 2022.
wiki.art.bars.dante-nyc.signature: Garibaldi (Campari + freshly fluffy-squeezed orange juice — their freshly squeezed technique is signature). Negroni Bianco. Negroni flight (12 variants). Italian-style aperitivo culture.
wiki.art.bars.dante-nyc.tips: Sunset view outdoor seating (MacDougal Street). Order Garibaldi — perfected version. Popular brunch.
wiki.art.bars.dante-nyc.sources: 50 Best Bars 2019 #1. Dante NYC website. Young & Pride interviews.
Double Chicken Please — Lower East Side NYC, opened 2020 by Faye Chen and GN Chan (ex-Angel's Share). World's 50 Best Bars #1 in 2023. Casual front room (simple cocktails + Japanese fried chicken sandwich), tasting back room with experimental cocktails.
Opened 2020 during pandemic. Ex-Angel's Share couple. Dual concept: chicken sandwich shop + back cocktail bar. World's 50 Best Bars #1 in 2023. Three rotating themed menus.
Waldorf Sandwich (cocktail tasting like Waldorf sandwich). Mango Sticky Rice (liquid version of Thai dessert). Culinary cocktails reproducing famous dish flavors.
Book back room ahead. Front room walk-in. Order chicken sandwich with themed cocktail. Unique concept worldwide.
50 Best Bars 2023 #1. NYT Restaurants review. Imbibe Magazine.
wiki.art.bars.katana-kitten-nyc.title: Katana Kitten
wiki.art.bars.katana-kitten-nyc.descript: Katana Kitten — West Village NYC, opened 2018 by Masahiro Urushido and Greg Boehm. Japanese-American highball bar. World's 50 Best Bars top 5 multiple years. Tokyo izakaya atmosphere with NYC details.
wiki.art.bars.katana-kitten-nyc.history: Opened May 2018. Urushido ex-Saxon + Parole and Angel's Share. Boehm co-founder, ex-Mother of Pearl and Macy's heritage. World's 50 Best Bars #14 in 2019, top 5 since 2020.
wiki.art.bars.katana-kitten-nyc.signatur: Hinoki Martini (gin + sake + suihida wood). Toki Highball (Suntory Toki). Yuzu Margarita. Japanese-American fusion cocktails.
wiki.art.bars.katana-kitten-nyc.tips: Reserve ahead. Relaxed atmosphere. Order highball to start — perfected technique. Excellent Japanese snacks.
wiki.art.bars.katana-kitten-nyc.sources: Katana Kitten NYC. Urushido, The Japanese Art of the Cocktail (2021). 50 Best Bars.
wiki.art.bars.the-aviary-chicago.title: The Aviary
wiki.art.bars.the-aviary-chicago.descrip: The Aviary — Chicago conceptual bar opened 2011 by Grant Achatz (Alinea 3-star Michelin chef-restaurateur) and Nick Kokonas. Cocktail program as fine-dining tasting menu. Pioneer of molecular and multisensory cocktail.
wiki.art.bars.the-aviary-chicago.history: Opened 2011 as complement to Alinea. Conceptualized as 'cocktail restaurant' — multi-course, radical scientific technique. Together with The Office, its exclusive underground speakeasy.
wiki.art.bars.the-aviary-chicago.signatu: Cocktails served in sealed glasses, on carved ice, with smoke, essences. Quarterly rotating program. Cocktails changing flavor while drinking (gradients).
wiki.art.bars.the-aviary-chicago.tips: Tasting experience essential (no walk-in). Book months ahead. Premium cost but unique worldwide. Visit The Office after for classics.
wiki.art.bars.the-aviary-chicago.sources: Aviary Cocktail Book (Achatz & Kokonas, 2018). Alinea Group. 50 Best Bars.
wiki.art.bars.the-violet-hour-chicago.de: The Violet Hour — Wicker Park speakeasy, Chicago, opened 2007. Pioneer of cocktail revival outside NYC. Hidden entrance with changing facade mural. Extensive classic-modern cocktail program.
wiki.art.bars.the-violet-hour-chicago.hi: Opened 2007 by Jason Cott. Toby Maloney head bartender at opening. Key influence on American midwest cocktail scene. Multiple successors trained here.
wiki.art.bars.the-violet-hour-chicago.si: Juliet & Romeo (gin + rose + cucumber + mint). Bourbon Sour. Quarterly rotating program. Classic cocktails reinterpreted with modern technique.
wiki.art.bars.the-violet-hour-chicago.ti: Walk-in usually, but waits on weekends. Traditional house rules (no cell phones). Order signature drinks like Juliet & Romeo.
wiki.art.bars.the-violet-hour-chicago.so: Violet Hour Chicago. Imbibe — Chicago cocktail scene. Punch Drink.
wiki.art.bars.trick-dog-sf.title: Trick Dog
wiki.art.bars.trick-dog-sf.description: Trick Dog — Mission District bar, San Francisco, opened 2013 by Bon Vivants (Josh Harris and Scott Baird). New themed menu every 6 months with extreme concept design (magazines, books, pizzerias…). World's 50 Best Bars top 30.
wiki.art.bars.trick-dog-sf.history: Opened 2013. Bon Vivants previously known for consultancy. Each new menu (every 6 months) requires extensive photoshoot + graphic design. Past concepts: National Geographic, Pizza Hut, Public Library.
wiki.art.bars.trick-dog-sf.signature: Cocktails always referencing current menu theme. Occasional Tiki program. SF craft beers.
wiki.art.bars.trick-dog-sf.tips: Ask about current menu and its theme. Open 4 PM-2 AM, walk-in. Weekend brunch.
wiki.art.bars.trick-dog-sf.sources: Trick Dog SF. Imbibe — Bon Vivants. 50 Best Bars.
wiki.art.bars.smugglers-cove-sf.title: Smuggler's Cove
wiki.art.bars.smugglers-cove-sf.descript: Smuggler's Cove — Tiki bar in Hayes Valley, San Francisco, opened 2009 by Martin Cate. Temple of contemporary Tiki with 400+ documented rums and rescued historic cocktails. World's largest rum collection.
wiki.art.bars.smugglers-cove-sf.history: Opened 2009. Cate rum expert since 2000s. Tiki historic cocktail program revised with modern technique. Cate published Smuggler's Cove (2016), reference book for Tiki revival.
wiki.art.bars.smugglers-cove-sf.signatur: Smuggler's Mai Tai. Hai Hou Le Punch. 400+ rum labels. Authentic Tiki decor (not kitsch). Educational Rum School.
wiki.art.bars.smugglers-cove-sf.tips: Three floors, progressive program. Visit downstairs first. Order rum flight to understand the genre. Cate's Smuggler's Cove (2016) is reference.
wiki.art.bars.smugglers-cove-sf.sources: Cate, Smuggler's Cove (2016). 50 Best Bars. Imbibe — Tiki revival.
wiki.art.bars.broken-shaker-miami.title: Broken Shaker
wiki.art.bars.broken-shaker-miami.descri: Broken Shaker — open-air bar at Freehand Hotel, Miami Beach, opened 2012 by Bar Lab (Gabriel Orta and Elad Zvi). Pioneer of contemporary tropical cocktail with Miami-Caribbean ingredients. Expansion to Chicago and NYC.
wiki.art.bars.broken-shaker-miami.histor: Opened 2012 at the Freehand. Bar Lab consultancy since 2008. Sister locations: Broken Shaker Chicago (2015), NYC (2017). Program based on local fruits and Caribbean rums.
wiki.art.bars.broken-shaker-miami.signat: Coconut Mojito (with fresh coconut). Mango Habanero Margarita. Contemporary Tiki riffs. Cocktails with authentic tropical ingredients.
wiki.art.bars.broken-shaker-miami.tips: Open-air bar — visit at sunset. Walk-in usually. Rotating program of seasonal ingredients.
wiki.art.bars.broken-shaker-miami.source: Broken Shaker / Bar Lab. Imbibe — Miami cocktail scene. 50 Best Bars North America.
wiki.art.bars.paradiso-bcn.title: Paradiso
wiki.art.bars.paradiso-bcn.description: Paradiso — El Born speakeasy, Barcelona, hidden behind a pastrami sandwich shop. Founded by Giacomo Giannotti (2014). World's 50 Best Bars #1 in 2022. Cocktail program with Spanish ingredients and hyperliquid techniques.
wiki.art.bars.paradiso-bcn.history: Opened 2014 when Giannotti transformed the space. Entry through Pastrami Bar freezer — unique concept. World's 50 Best Bars #1 in 2022. Rotating themed cocktail program. Multiple world awards.
wiki.art.bars.paradiso-bcn.signature: Brexit (gin + cardamom + coconut water — political mix). Cocktails with molecular cooking. Changing narrative program.
wiki.art.bars.paradiso-bcn.tips: Reserve ahead. Limited capacity. Entry through Pastrami Bar fridge (Rera Palau 4). Order current menu cocktail.
wiki.art.bars.paradiso-bcn.sources: 50 Best Bars 2022 #1. Paradiso Barcelona. Imbibe — Giannotti profile.
wiki.art.bars.dr-stravinsky-bcn.title: Dr. Stravinsky
wiki.art.bars.dr-stravinsky-bcn.descript: Dr. Stravinsky — El Born bar, Barcelona, opened 2016 by Anthony Pasquette. Pharmacy-cocktail concept with in-house distilled tinctures and elixirs. World's 50 Best Bars top 30. Authentic apothecary decor.
wiki.art.bars.dr-stravinsky-bcn.history: Opened 2016. Pasquette French, ex-Mary Celeste and Le Coq Paris. Bar designed with antique jars, in-house tinctures. Cocktail program with own distillates.
wiki.art.bars.dr-stravinsky-bcn.signatur: Cocktails with local botanical tinctures. Coffee Tonic. Rotating program based on in-house distillation.
wiki.art.bars.dr-stravinsky-bcn.tips: Reserve ahead. Conceptual and technical. Order cocktails with own tinctures to understand concept.
wiki.art.bars.dr-stravinsky-bcn.sources: Dr. Stravinsky BCN. 50 Best Bars. Imbibe — BCN bar scene.
wiki.art.bars.sips-bcn.title: Sips
wiki.art.bars.sips-bcn.description: Sips — contemporary Marc Álvarez and Simone Caporale bar in Barcelona, opened 2021. World's 50 Best Bars #1 in 2023, #2 in 2024. Elegant style focused on cocktails evolving in presentation.
wiki.art.bars.sips-bcn.history: Opened 2021 by Álvarez (ex-Tickets BBVA and Tony's Bar BCN) and Caporale (ex-Artesian London). World's 50 Best Bars #3 in 2022, #1 in 2023. Concept: curated tasting bar.
wiki.art.bars.sips-bcn.signature: Cocktails served on narrative tray (visual presentation + accompaniment). Rotating program with conceptual themes (vintage clothing, futurism…).
wiki.art.bars.sips-bcn.tips: Reservation essential months ahead. Curated service, very limited capacity. Order tasting cocktail menu (6-8 servings).
wiki.art.bars.sips-bcn.sources: 50 Best Bars 2023 #1, 2024 #2. Sips BCN. Imbibe — Caporale Álvarez profile.
wiki.art.bars.two-schmucks-bcn.title: Two Schmucks
wiki.art.bars.two-schmucks-bcn.descripti: Two Schmucks — informal and fun cocktail bar in El Raval, Barcelona, founded by Moe Aljaff and AJ White in 2017. World's 50 Best Bars top 20. Philosophy: 'guess we'll just make a banger cocktail'. Anti-professional pretension.
wiki.art.bars.two-schmucks-bcn.history: Opened 2017 with shoestring budget. Aljaff Syrian-Swiss, White Australian-Irish. Anti-formal — no reservations, no dress code, punk music. World's 50 Best Bars #41 (2020), top 10 (2022).
wiki.art.bars.two-schmucks-bcn.signature: Perfected Espresso Martini. Humorous cocktails (irreverent names). Heavy menu rotation based on what they have that month.
wiki.art.bars.two-schmucks-bcn.tips: Walk-in, arrive early. Small bar on Carrer de Sant Pau. Local punk-friendly bar vibes. Order any cocktail and prepare for banter.
wiki.art.bars.two-schmucks-bcn.sources: Two Schmucks BCN. 50 Best Bars. Imbibe — anti-cocktail scene.
wiki.art.bars.schilling-bcn.title: Schilling
wiki.art.bars.schilling-bcn.description: Schilling — historic El Born bar (Carrer Ferran), opened 1880. One of Barcelona's oldest continuously operating. Original Catalan Modernist atmosphere with period mirrors and carved wood bar.
wiki.art.bars.schilling-bcn.history: Founded 1880 as bohemian tertulia. Survived civil wars and revolutions keeping Modernist decor intact. Partially restored in 2000s preserving 1900s atmosphere.
wiki.art.bars.schilling-bcn.signature: Homemade vermut (served traditionally with siphon). Pre-Prohibition classic cocktails. Tapas paired with vermut.
wiki.art.bars.schilling-bcn.tips: Visit for history and heritage. Ideal for afternoon vermut before dinner. Las Ramblas nearby, touristy location but authentic.
wiki.art.bars.schilling-bcn.sources: Patrimoni de la Generalitat. Barcelona Heritage. Time Out Barcelona — historic bars.
wiki.art.bars.boadas-bcn.title: Boadas
wiki.art.bars.boadas-bcn.description: Boadas — iconic Ramblas bar, Barcelona, founded 1933 by Miguel Boadas (Cuban of Catalan origin). Barcelona's oldest cocktail bar. Famous for its spectacular throw mixing technique.
wiki.art.bars.boadas-bcn.history: Miguel Boadas (1895-1967) opened in 1933 after returning from Havana where he learned cocktail. Hemingway, Joan Miró among clients. Still run by descendants. Throw spectacle preserved.
wiki.art.bars.boadas-bcn.signature: Boadas-style Mojito (with throw technique). Original Cuban Daiquiri. Aperitivo Boadas (signature). Intact Art Deco atmosphere.
wiki.art.bars.boadas-bcn.tips: Small, very small. Reservation difficult. Visit midday or early evening. Watch the antique Cuban throw technique.
wiki.art.bars.boadas-bcn.sources: Boadas Cocktail Bar. BCN gastronomic history. Time Out Barcelona.
wiki.art.bars.salmon-guru-madrid.title: Salmón Gurú
wiki.art.bars.salmon-guru-madrid.descrip: Salmón Gurú — colorful cocktail bar in Las Letras quarter, Madrid, founded 2017 by Diego Cabrera. Irreverent aesthetic with mermaids, neons and kitsch decor. World's 50 Best Bars top 10. Diego Cabrera media figure of Spanish cocktail.
wiki.art.bars.salmon-guru-madrid.history: Cabrera (Argentine) opened in 2017 after Le Cabrera success. Contemporary anti-elegance aesthetic. World's 50 Best Bars top 30 since 2018, top 10 more recently. Cabrera most famous bartender in Spain.
wiki.art.bars.salmon-guru-madrid.signatu: Cocktails with visual humor (served in absurd glasses — fish, dinosaur, lamp). Salmón Negroni with own techniques. Rotating Cabrera program.
wiki.art.bars.salmon-guru-madrid.tips: Reserve ahead. Fun atmosphere, don't take seriously. Order visual cocktail — presentation is part of concept.
wiki.art.bars.salmon-guru-madrid.sources: Salmón Gurú Madrid. Diego Cabrera. 50 Best Bars. El País — Cabrera.
wiki.art.bars.1862-dry-bar-madrid.title: 1862 Dry Bar
wiki.art.bars.1862-dry-bar-madrid.descri: 1862 Dry Bar — classic bar in Malasaña, Madrid, opened 2014. Name honoring publication year of Jerry Thomas's book. Pre-Prohibition bar atmosphere with meticulously classic cocktails. World's 50 Best Bars top 50.
wiki.art.bars.1862-dry-bar-madrid.histor: Opened 2014. Owner Alberto Pizarro. Concept: revive golden age of American classic cocktail in Madrid. Strict program of properly prepared classics.
wiki.art.bars.1862-dry-bar-madrid.signat: 1937-style Sazerac. Perfectionist Manhattan. Brandy Crusta. Strict pre-Prohibition revival program.
wiki.art.bars.1862-dry-bar-madrid.tips: Reserve. Order classics — not bar for experimental signature drinks. Wondrich-style cocktails.
wiki.art.bars.1862-dry-bar-madrid.source: 1862 Dry Bar Madrid. 50 Best Bars. Time Out Madrid.
wiki.art.bars.viva-madrid.title: Viva Madrid
wiki.art.bars.viva-madrid.description: Viva Madrid — historic Huertas tavern (Calle Manuel Fernández y González), opened 1856. One of Madrid's oldest. Famous for original ceramic tilework. Traditional Madrid tavern atmosphere.
wiki.art.bars.viva-madrid.history: Opened 1856 as pre-Liberal tavern. Survived political changes keeping original decor (Manises workshop tiles). Renovated in 2000s preserving heritage.
wiki.art.bars.viva-madrid.signature: Homemade vermut. Pre-cocktail-revival traditional drinks focusing on sherry. Traditional Madrid tapas. 19th-century literary tertulia atmosphere.
wiki.art.bars.viva-madrid.tips: Visit during tertulia hours (afternoon). Extended hours in Huertas area. Order vermut with tapa for authentic experience.
wiki.art.bars.viva-madrid.sources: Madrid Heritage. Madrid gastronomic history. Historic Madrid taverns.
Salvador Bachiller — historic Madrid bar (Carrera de San Jerónimo) opened in early 20th century. Frequented by Generation of '98 bohemians (Valle-Inclán, Baroja, Azorín). Preserves literary atmosphere.
Founded early 20th century. Frequent literary tertulia site. Restored keeping original wooden bar, mirrors and furniture. Still operating on Carrera San Jerónimo.
House vermut. 20th-century Spanish classic cocktails. Traditional anises. Preserved literary tertulia atmosphere.
To know literary Madrid. Visit early evening. Good selection of Spanish anises and aguardientes.
Madrid gastronomic heritage. Historic Madrid taverns. Generation of '98.
wiki.art.bars.the-clumsies-athens.title: The Clumsies
wiki.art.bars.the-clumsies-athens.descri: The Clumsies — contemporary cocktail bar in Athens, opened 2014 by Nikos Bakoulis and Vassilis Kyritsis. World's 50 Best Bars top 10 multiple years. Modern Greek bar design focusing on Mediterranean ingredients.
wiki.art.bars.the-clumsies-athens.histor: Opened 2014. Bakoulis and Kyritsis previously worked in Athens bars. Concept: contemporary cocktail bar with Greek identity. 50 Best Bars #19 in 2016, top 10 since 2018.
wiki.art.bars.the-clumsies-athens.signat: Cocktails with local ingredients (masticha, ouzo, Greek wines). Souma Sour. Greek terroir cocktail program.
wiki.art.bars.the-clumsies-athens.tips: Reserve. Elegant modern atmosphere. Order cocktails with masticha or ouzo for authentic Greek experience.
wiki.art.bars.the-clumsies-athens.source: The Clumsies Athens. 50 Best Bars. Bakoulis & Kyritsis interviews.
wiki.art.bars.baba-au-rum-athens.title: Baba au Rum
wiki.art.bars.baba-au-rum-athens.descrip: Baba au Rum — contemporary Athens Tiki bar, opened 2009 by Thanos Prunarus. Pioneer of Tiki in Greece. World's 50 Best Bars top 50. 200+ documented rums with Caribbean agricole focus.
wiki.art.bars.baba-au-rum-athens.history: Opened 2009. Prunarus consultant for Plantation Rum and international ambassador. Modern Tiki program with precise technique. Key influence on Greek cocktail scene.
wiki.art.bars.baba-au-rum-athens.signatu: Perfected Mai Tai. Painkiller. Rum tasting flights. Tiki cocktails with Mediterranean ingredients (citrus, ouzo).
wiki.art.bars.baba-au-rum-athens.tips: Reserve. Tiki atmosphere without excessive kitsch. Order rum flight to understand Caribbean categories.
wiki.art.bars.baba-au-rum-athens.sources: Baba au Rum Athens. 50 Best Bars. Plantation Rum brand.
wiki.art.bars.the-old-fashioned-athens.d: The Old Fashioned — classic cocktail bar in Athens (Kolonaki), opened 2017. Focus on properly prepared classics with premium ingredients. Traditional masculine bar atmosphere with dark woods and imposing bar.
wiki.art.bars.the-old-fashioned-athens.h: Opened 2017. Concept: classic cocktail revival in English bar style. Strict program of pre-Prohibition and post-WWII drinks. Adjacent whisky lounge.
wiki.art.bars.the-old-fashioned-athens.s: Old Fashioned variants (extensive program). Perfected Negroni. Traditional Manhattan. Extensive Scotch whisky program.
wiki.art.bars.the-old-fashioned-athens.t: Refined atmosphere. Reserve. Good place for pure Old Fashioned or regional variants.
wiki.art.bars.the-old-fashioned-athens.s: The Old Fashioned Athens. Time Out Athens. Greek cocktail scene.
wiki.art.bars.le-syndicat-paris.title: Le Syndicat
wiki.art.bars.le-syndicat-paris.descript: Le Syndicat — Parisian bar dedicated exclusively to French spirits, opened 2014 by Sullivan Doh. Punk decor with duct tape. 100% French distillates program (Cognac, Calvados, Armagnac, French gins). World's 50 Best Bars top 50.
wiki.art.bars.le-syndicat-paris.history: Opened 2014 in 10e arrondissement, Faubourg-Saint-Denis street. Doh is French spirits activist — program to challenge Anglo dominance. Anti-formal atmosphere with poster art.
wiki.art.bars.le-syndicat-paris.signatur: 100% French spirits cocktails. Calvados Old Fashioned. Cognac Sour. Armagnac highball. Anti-Imperialist Cocktail (humor).
wiki.art.bars.le-syndicat-paris.tips: Walk-in usually. Punk atmosphere. Order cocktail with Calvados or Cognac to understand concept.
wiki.art.bars.le-syndicat-paris.sources: Le Syndicat Paris. 50 Best Bars. Doh — French spirits activism.
wiki.art.bars.little-red-door-paris.desc: Little Red Door — Parisian speakeasy in Le Marais, opened 2011 by Rémy Savage and co-founders. Entry through discreet red door. World's 50 Best Bars top 10 multiple years. Conceptual cocktail program with rotating themed menus.
wiki.art.bars.little-red-door-paris.hist: Opened 2011. Savage head bartender until London move (A Bar With Shapes 2021). Multiple world awards since 2015. Concept inspired by NYC speakeasy + Parisian bar.
wiki.art.bars.little-red-door-paris.sign: Cocktails with conceptual thematic narratives. Menu changes every 6 months with guest artist. 19th-century Parisian salon atmosphere.
wiki.art.bars.little-red-door-paris.tips: Reserve. Intimate atmosphere. Order cocktail from current themed menu — always has story behind it.
wiki.art.bars.little-red-door-paris.sour: Little Red Door Paris. 50 Best Bars 2018, 2020. Punch Drink — Rémy Savage.
wiki.art.bars.candelaria-paris.title: Candelaria
wiki.art.bars.candelaria-paris.descripti: Candelaria — taquería + speakeasy in Le Marais, Paris, opened 2011 by Carina Soto Velásquez and Adrián Núñez. Casual front taquería, hidden back cocktail bar. World's 50 Best Bars top 30. Pioneer of hybrid taquería-bar concept in Europe.
wiki.art.bars.candelaria-paris.history: Opened 2011 by Mexican/Colombian co-founders. Front shop serves artisanal tacos; back room speakeasy with Latin-French fusion cocktails. Multiple awards since 2014.
wiki.art.bars.candelaria-paris.signature: Latin-Paris fusion cocktails. Mezcal Negroni. Daiquiri with Latin tropical fruits. Authentic tacos in front shop.
wiki.art.bars.candelaria-paris.tips: Front taquería walk-in. Back bar reserve. Order mezcal cocktail with tacos. Relaxed multicultural atmosphere.
wiki.art.bars.candelaria-paris.sources: Candelaria Paris. 50 Best Bars. Imbibe Magazine — Paris cocktail scene.
wiki.art.bars.lulu-white-paris.title: Lulu White
wiki.art.bars.lulu-white-paris.descripti: Lulu White — decadent absinthe and cocktail bar in Pigalle, Paris, opened 2013. Named after pre-WWI famous New Orleans madam. Belle Époque burlesque decor with zinc marquetry.
wiki.art.bars.lulu-white-paris.history: Opened 2013 at 12 Rue Frochot. Concept based on Belle Époque Pigalle bar (1900s). Cocktail program focused on absinthe and historic bitters.
wiki.art.bars.lulu-white-paris.signature: Sazerac with quality absinthe. Death in the Afternoon (Hemingway). Cocktails with absinthe as main ingredient. Vintage burlesque atmosphere.
wiki.art.bars.lulu-white-paris.tips: Small, reserve. Intimate nighttime atmosphere. Order traditional absinthe preparation (fountain drip).
wiki.art.bars.lulu-white-paris.sources: Lulu White Paris. Imbibe — Paris bar scene. Difford's Guide.
wiki.art.bars.drink-kong-rome.title: Drink Kong
wiki.art.bars.drink-kong-rome.descriptio: Drink Kong — Tokyo-cyberpunk bar in Rome, opened 2018 by Patrick Pistolesi. Blade Runner-inspired aesthetics with neons, plastic and screens. World's 50 Best Bars top 20. Cocktail program focused on sake and Japanese whisky.
wiki.art.bars.drink-kong-rome.history: Pistolesi (ex-Jerry Thomas Project) opened Drink Kong in 2018. Unique European concept: Japan-meets-Italy bar with cyberpunk aesthetic. World's 50 Best Bars #16 (2020), top 20 since.
wiki.art.bars.drink-kong-rome.signature: Cocktails with sake and Italian liquor fusion. Perfected highballs with Japanese technique. Sushi food pairing menu. Unique atmosphere.
wiki.art.bars.drink-kong-rome.tips: Reserve ahead. Vibrant atmosphere. Order sake cocktail or highball. Complete foodie trip with food pairing.
wiki.art.bars.drink-kong-rome.sources: Drink Kong Roma. 50 Best Bars. Patrick Pistolesi interviews.
Jerry Thomas Project — Rome speakeasy, opened 2010 by Roberto Artusio and co-founders. Italian temple of American classic pre-Prohibition cocktail. World's 50 Best Bars top 50. Password required for entry.
Opened 2010 in Vicolo Cellini. Concept: revive golden age of American classic cocktail. Strict program based on Wondrich books and Jerry Thomas books. Password renews monthly.
Pre-Prohibition program (all classics). Hot Toddy with historic technique. Manhattan, Sazerac, Brandy Crusta. Rotating Italian bartenders program.
Reservation essential — current password by email. Formal but relaxed atmosphere. Order classics — not bar for signature drinks.
Jerry Thomas Project. 50 Best Bars. Wondrich, Imbibe!. Italian cocktail bars.
wiki.art.bars.freni-e-frizioni-rome.desc: Freni e Frizioni — iconic Roman bar in Trastevere opened 2007 in former motorcycle workshop (Mecánica Freni e Frizioni). Urban atmosphere with graffiti and old woods. Relaxed Italian aperitivo culture with elevated cocktail.
wiki.art.bars.freni-e-frizioni-rome.hist: Opened 2007 in former motorcycle workshop. Ex-industrial atmosphere preserved. Pioneer of contemporary Roman aperitivo-cocktail. View to Piazza Trilussa and Tiber.
wiki.art.bars.freni-e-frizioni-rome.sign: Negronis (extensive program). Perfected Aperol Spritz. Contemporary cocktails with Italian ingredients.
wiki.art.bars.freni-e-frizioni-rome.tips: Classic Italian aperitivo — includes buffet with cocktail (6:30-9 PM). Arrive early for outdoor seat (river view).
wiki.art.bars.freni-e-frizioni-rome.sour: Freni e Frizioni Roma. Time Out Roma. Imbibe — Roma bar scene.
wiki.art.bars.alquimico-cartagena.title: Alquímico
wiki.art.bars.alquimico-cartagena.descri: Alquímico — cocktail bar in Cartagena de Indias, Colombia, opened 2014 by Jean Trinh. World's 50 Best Bars top 20 — Latin America's best-ranked bar. Three levels with distinct programs. Cocktails with Caribbean and Colombian ingredients.
wiki.art.bars.alquimico-cartagena.histor: Opened 2014. Trinh French naturalized Colombian. Concept: Colombian bar of high international level. World's 50 Best Bars #20 (2019), top 10 (2022, 2023). Latin America's top bar.
wiki.art.bars.alquimico-cartagena.signat: Cocktails with Colombian rum, lulo, passion fruit. Program by levels: 1st casual, 2nd cocktails, 3rd terrace. Sustainability with local ingredients.
wiki.art.bars.alquimico-cartagena.tips: Reservation essential. Visit all 3 levels. Order Colombian cocktails with native fruits. Vibrant Caribbean atmosphere.
wiki.art.bars.alquimico-cartagena.source: Alquímico Cartagena. 50 Best Bars 2022, 2023. Imbibe Magazine.
wiki.art.bars.x-spit-singapore.title: 28 HongKong Street
wiki.art.bars.x-spit-singapore.descripti: 28 HongKong Street — iconic Singapore bar, opened 2011 by Proof & Company. Pioneer of Asian cocktail revival. World's 50 Best Bars top 20 multiple years. Modern speakeasy temple in Asia.
wiki.art.bars.x-spit-singapore.history: Opened 2011. Concept: NYC speakeasy applied to Asia. Trained several bartenders who would open bars throughout Asia. Multiple awards. Still operating (28 Hong Kong Street).
wiki.art.bars.x-spit-singapore.signature: Perfected classic cocktails NYC-style. Quarterly rotating program. Exposed brick atmosphere, intimate seating.
wiki.art.bars.x-spit-singapore.tips: Reserve. Relaxed atmosphere — not formal. Order classic cocktail or current signature. Good food pairing.
wiki.art.bars.x-spit-singapore.sources: 28 HongKong Street. 50 Best Bars Asia. Proof & Company.
wiki.art.bars.manhattan-singapore.title: Manhattan
wiki.art.bars.manhattan-singapore.descri: Manhattan — Regent Singapore bar, opened 2014. Replica of NYC Prohibition-era speakeasy. World's 50 Best Bars top 10 multiple years. Cocktail program divided into 4 NYC themed 'districts' (Wall Street, West Village…).
wiki.art.bars.manhattan-singapore.histor: Opened 2014 at Regent Singapore. Conception by Philip Bischoff (head bartender). World's 50 Best Bars #11 (2018), top 5 since 2019. Changing programmatic program.
wiki.art.bars.manhattan-singapore.signat: Cocktails inspired by NYC districts (each with narrative). Manhattan signature in own round. Belle Époque atmosphere.
wiki.art.bars.manhattan-singapore.tips: Reserve ahead. Smart dress code. Visit all 4 'districts' of themed menu. Panoramic Singapore view.
wiki.art.bars.manhattan-singapore.source: Manhattan Bar Singapore. 50 Best Bars. Regent Singapore.
wiki.art.bars.atlas-singapore.title: Atlas
wiki.art.bars.atlas-singapore.descriptio: Atlas — Parkview Square Hotel bar, Singapore, opened 2017. Spectacular Art Deco decor with 3-story gin tower (1300+ gins). World's 50 Best Bars top 5 multiple years. Unique concept worldwide.
wiki.art.bars.atlas-singapore.history: Opened 2017 in newly built art deco architecture. World's most extensive gin program (1300+ gins). Focus on perfected gin & tonics. Multiple world awards.
wiki.art.bars.atlas-singapore.signature: Gin & Tonic flights (by geographic zone). Atlas Negroni (with own signature gin). Educational G&T flights by geographic origin.
wiki.art.bars.atlas-singapore.tips: Reserve ahead. Formal dress code. Order G&T flight to understand global gin genre. Panoramic Singapore view.
wiki.art.bars.atlas-singapore.sources: Atlas Singapore. 50 Best Bars 2020, 2022. Parkview Square Hotel.
wiki.art.bars.high-five-tokyo.title: Bar High Five
wiki.art.bars.high-five-tokyo.descriptio: Bar High Five — Ginza Tokyo bar, run by Hidetsugu Ueno. One of the world's most recognized Japanese-style bars. Exclusive bartender's choice program with technique perfected in every gesture.
wiki.art.bars.high-five-tokyo.history: Ueno previously worked at Tender Bar (Tokyo) under Kazuo Uyeda. Opened Bar High Five in Ginza 2008. Considered one of the world's top 3-5 bartenders. Limited capacity (~12 people).
wiki.art.bars.high-five-tokyo.signature: Bartender's choice — no menu. Hand-carved diamond ice. Hard shake technique. Highball precision. Meditative cocktail experience.
wiki.art.bars.high-five-tokyo.tips: Reserve months ahead. No menu — say what you like and let bartender decide. Unique experience (45-60 min). About 12 seat capacity.
wiki.art.bars.high-five-tokyo.sources: Bar High Five Tokyo. Ueno, Cocktail Technique. World's 50 Best Bars.
wiki.art.bars.bar-bench-tokyo.title: Bar Benfiddich
wiki.art.bars.bar-bench-tokyo.descriptio: Bar Benfiddich — Tokyo Shinjuku bar run by Hiroyasu Kayama. Pioneer of 'forage cocktail' — bartender forages own herbs in Japan's mountains. World's 50 Best Bars top 30. 100% Japanese wild ingredients cocktail program.
wiki.art.bars.bar-bench-tokyo.history: Kayama opened Benfiddich 2013. Forages wild herbs in Japan mountains monthly. In-house tinctures and syrups. World's 50 Best Bars multiple years.
wiki.art.bars.bar-bench-tokyo.signature: Cocktails with foraged herb tinctures (mugwort, sansho, yuzu peel). Absinthe-style aperitifs. Unique cocktail experience.
wiki.art.bars.bar-bench-tokyo.tips: Reservation essential. Small capacity. Order signature forage cocktail — storytelling is part of experience.
wiki.art.bars.bar-bench-tokyo.sources: Bar Benfiddich Tokyo. 50 Best Bars. Imbibe — Tokyo bars.
wiki.art.bars.tender-bar-tokyo.title: Tender Bar
wiki.art.bars.tender-bar-tokyo.descripti: Tender Bar — Ginza Tokyo bar led by Kazuo Uyeda. World's most historic and influential Japanese-style bar. Uyeda is father of hard shake technique. Operating since 1990s.
wiki.art.bars.tender-bar-tokyo.history: Uyeda opened Tender Bar in early 1990s in Ginza, after decades-long career. Codified hard shake technique in his book Cocktail Technique (1996). Considered father of modern Japanese bartending.
wiki.art.bars.tender-bar-tokyo.signature: Cocktails with hard shake technique. Tender Daiquiri (perfected). Highball precision. Hand-carved ice diamonds. Bartending as ritual art.
wiki.art.bars.tender-bar-tokyo.tips: Reservation essential. Silent, meditative atmosphere. Order cocktail with hard shake — unique experience. Limited capacity.
wiki.art.bars.tender-bar-tokyo.sources: Uyeda, Cocktail Technique (1996). Imbibe — Japanese bartending. World's 50 Best Bars.
wiki.art.bars.star-bar-tokyo.title: Star Bar
wiki.art.bars.star-bar-tokyo.description: Star Bar Ginza — Tokyo Ginza bar led by Hisashi Kishi. Temple of Japanese Martini with precise technique. World's 50 Best Bars top 30 multiple years. Silent, meditative, maximally refined atmosphere.
wiki.art.bars.star-bar-tokyo.history: Kishi opened Star Bar Ginza in late 1990s. Disciple of Uyeda school. Classic cocktail program with perfected Japanese technique. Son Tatsuya Kishi continues tradition.
wiki.art.bars.star-bar-tokyo.signature: Japanese Martini (chilled gin, specific vermouth, meditative stirring technique). Classic cocktails with Japanese technique. Hand-carved ice.
wiki.art.bars.star-bar-tokyo.tips: Reserve ahead. Silent atmosphere, formal dress code. Order Star Bar Martini for key Japanese experience.
wiki.art.bars.star-bar-tokyo.sources: Star Bar Ginza Tokyo. 50 Best Bars. Imbibe — Japanese bartending.
wiki.art.bars.hanky-panky-mexico.title: Hanky Panky
wiki.art.bars.hanky-panky-mexico.descrip: Hanky Panky — Mexican speakeasy in Roma Norte, CDMX, opened 2014. Entry through discreet interior door. World's 50 Best Bars top 10 multiple years. Concept: mythic contemporary Mexican bar focusing on mezcal and tequila.
wiki.art.bars.hanky-panky-mexico.history: Opened 2014. Concept by Walter Meyenberg and co-founders. Named after Ada Coleman's Hanky Panky. World's 50 Best Bars top 20 since 2018, top 10 more recently.
wiki.art.bars.hanky-panky-mexico.signatu: Cocktails with Mexican mezcal and tequila. Hanky Panky variants honoring Ada. In-house infusion focus. Mexican-meets-British style.
wiki.art.bars.hanky-panky-mexico.tips: Reserve. Walk-in difficult. Intimate atmosphere. Order Hanky Panky variant.
wiki.art.bars.hanky-panky-mexico.sources: Hanky Panky CDMX. 50 Best Bars 2020, 2022. Imbibe Magazine.
wiki.art.bars.licoreria-limantour-mexico: Licorería Limantour — Roma Norte bar, CDMX, opened 2011 by José Luis León. Pioneer of modern Mexican cocktail. World's 50 Best Bars top 10 multiple years. #1 50 Best Bars Latin America multiple times.
Opened 2011. León previously Bar Milán. Concept: international Mexican cocktail bar. Multiple awards. Sister Limantour-Hermosillo. Defining influence on Mexican scene.
Margarita Al Pastor (with pineapple and chili). Limantour Old Fashioned with mezcal. Cocktails with premium Mexican ingredients. Rotating program.
Reserve. Vibrant atmosphere. Order signature Mexican cocktail — Margarita Al Pastor is essential.
Licorería Limantour. 50 Best Bars Latin America #1. Imbibe Mexico City.
wiki.art.bars.fifty-mils-mexico.title: Fifty Mils
wiki.art.bars.fifty-mils-mexico.descript: Fifty Mils — Four Seasons Mexico City bar, opened 2014. Led by Mica Rousseau (head bartender). World's 50 Best Bars top 30. Cocktail program with premium Mexican ingredients in five-star hotel.
wiki.art.bars.fifty-mils-mexico.history: Opened 2014. Four Seasons concept, led by Rousseau. Formal cocktail program focused on mezcal, tequila and Mexican rum. International recognition since 2018.
wiki.art.bars.fifty-mils-mexico.signatur: Cocktails with artisanal mezcal. Perfected Margarita. Mexican Negroni. Program with premium local ingredients (chiles, herbs, fruits).
wiki.art.bars.fifty-mils-mexico.tips: Reserve. Smart dress code. Ideal for elegant early night. Order mezcal flight to understand varieties.
wiki.art.bars.fifty-mils-mexico.sources: Fifty Mils Four Seasons. 50 Best Bars. Rousseau interviews.
wiki.art.science.balance-sweet-sour-stro: Fundamental cocktail balance: combine sweetness (syrup, sweet liqueurs), acidity (citrus, vinegar) and strength (distillate). David Embury in The Fine Art of Mixing Drinks (1948) codified the 8:3:2 formula (spirit:sweet:sour) as gold standard.

Balanced taste perception requires no single note dominating. The human brain perceives harmony when sweet, sour and alcohol balance within sensory thresholds (sweetness 8-12g/100ml, acidity 0.5-1% citric).
Daiquiri (rum + lime + sugar 8:3:2). Margarita (tequila + Cointreau + lime). Sidecar. Whiskey Sour. Everything ending in 'sour' is this equation.
Start with 8:3:2 and adjust to distillate: aged rums need less sugar (barrel adds sweetness); dry gins may need more.
Embury, The Fine Art of Mixing Drinks (1948). Wondrich, Imbibe! (2007). Death & Co Cocktail Codex (2018).
Acidity in cocktails is measured as % citric acid equivalent. Lime juice 5-7%, lemon 5-6%, vinegar 5-6%, kombucha 0.5-1.5%. Typical balanced cocktail has 0.5-1% total acidity.
Different acids (citric, malic, tartaric, acetic, lactic) have distinct sensory profiles. Citric is bright; malic (apple) is smooth; tartaric (grape) is long; acetic (vinegar) is sharp.
Mojito (citric lime — bright). Clarified Whiskey Sour (citric acid isolated). Shrub cocktails (acetic — vinegar based). White vermouth (malic + tartaric).
To reduce aggressiveness of high-acid cocktails, use 50:50 citric + malic acid solution — more rounded mouthfeel.
Arnold, Liquid Intelligence (2014). Cocktail Codex (Death & Co, 2018). Punch Drink — acidity science.
wiki.art.science.balance-bitterness-curv: Bitterness activates tongue T2R receptors, increases with concentration but saturates quickly (sigmoidal saturation curve). Bitter amaros have 5-20mg quinine equivalent / 100ml. Classic Negroni (1:1:1) has ~30mg quinine equivalent.

Humans have 25 T2R receptors. Bitter suppression by sweetness operates via receptor crosstalk. Bitter ingredients (Angostura, Fernet, Campari) saturate quickly — adding more doesn't proportionally increase bitterness.
Negroni (gin + Campari + vermouth). Old Fashioned (with Angostura 2-3 dashes). Toronto (rye + Fernet). Trinidad Sour (1.5oz Angostura).
Extreme bitterness calms via bitter suppression: add trace salt or glucose. To train palate, try ascending amaro flight.
Spence, Gastrophysics (2017). Punch Drink — bitterness science. Cocktail Codex (2018).
wiki.art.science.dilution-shaking-vs-sti: Shake adds 25-35% water through ice dilution + aeration; stir adds 15-25% water without aeration. Choice depends on cocktail: shake for citrus and dairy (needs aeration), stir for spirits-only (clarity and silky texture).
Moving ice (shake) transfers heat faster = greater dilution per time unit. Stir is laminar, transfers slow. Shake aeration incorporates N₂/O₂, changes texture and sensory temperature.
Martini (stirred — clear, silky). Manhattan (stirred). Old Fashioned (stir-built). Daiquiri (shaken — citrus, aerated). Whiskey Sour (shaken). Penicillin (shaken — citrus).
Rule: if it has citrus, dairy or egg, shake. If it's spirit + spirit + bitter, stir. Stir 30-45 seconds for perfect Martini.
Arnold, Liquid Intelligence (2014). Morgenthaler, The Bar Book (2014). Embury (1948).
