wiki.art.techniques.bottle-aging.how: Bottle cocktail, refrigerate or room temp. No O₂ excess. Wait 1-6 months.
wiki.art.techniques.bottle-aging.when: Bottled batched cocktails. Vintage cocktail experiments.
wiki.art.techniques.bottle-aging.tips: Dark bottles protect from light. Hermetic seal. Refrigerated extends life.
wiki.art.techniques.barrel-aging-cocktai: Barrel aging cocktail in small barrels (1-5L) for weeks. Wood adds vanillin, tannins. Speeds cocktail maturation.
Neutral mini-barrel (apple, cherry, oak char). Fill with cocktail. Wait 2-6 weeks. Taste regularly.
Barrel-aged Negroni (2-4 weeks). Barrel-aged Manhattan. Tuthilltown cocktails.
For home: 1L mini-barrels (~$80). Taste every 1-2 weeks. Eventually over-extracts.
wiki.art.techniques.vermouth-rinse.title: Vermouth rinse
wiki.art.techniques.vermouth-rinse.descr: Vermouth rinse coats glass interior with vermouth and dumps excess. Adds subtle aroma without diluting cocktail. Modern Martini standard.
wiki.art.techniques.vermouth-rinse.how: Pour vermouth in cold glass. Swirl to coat interior. Dump excess.
wiki.art.techniques.vermouth-rinse.when: Modern Dry Martini. In and Out Martini. Vermouth-focused cocktails without dominant vermouth.
wiki.art.techniques.vermouth-rinse.tips: Stir gin with ice. Frozen glass + vermouth rinse + strain gin. Result: trace vermouth aroma.
wiki.art.techniques.absinthe-rinse.title: Absinthe rinse
wiki.art.techniques.absinthe-rinse.descr: Absinthe rinse coats glass with absinthe before pouring cocktail. Adds intense anise aroma without much dilution. Sazerac signature.
wiki.art.techniques.absinthe-rinse.how: 1 dash absinthe in frozen glass. Swirl to coat. Dump excess. Pour cocktail (rye + bitter + sugar).
wiki.art.techniques.absinthe-rinse.when: Sazerac (rye base). Improved Whiskey Cocktail. Cocktails with absinthe trace aroma.
wiki.art.techniques.absinthe-rinse.tips: Pernod, Lucid, Henri Bardouin absinthe. Only 1 dash — otherwise dominates.
wiki.art.techniques.absinthe-rinse.sourc: Wondrich, Imbibe!. Sazerac House New Orleans.
wiki.art.techniques.torch-charring.title: Torch charring
wiki.art.techniques.torch-charring.descr: Torch charring burns fruit/garnish with butane torch. Surface caramelization adds smoky/caramel flavor. Dramatic visual.
wiki.art.techniques.torch-charring.how: Butane chef torch. 5-10cm distance. Short flame to golden-brown. Not too much.
wiki.art.techniques.torch-charring.when: Charred orange peel. Caramelized pineapple. Brûlée garnish.
wiki.art.techniques.torch-charring.tips: Practice before show. Color/flavor off if excessive. Caramel notes are ideal.
wiki.art.techniques.salt-air-foam.title: Salt air foam
wiki.art.techniques.salt-air-foam.descri: Salt air foam is light salinity foam created with soy lecithin. Floating foam on cocktail with salty flavor.
wiki.art.techniques.salt-air-foam.how: Saline solution (saltwater) + soy lecithin (1% weight). Hand-blend until light foam. Spoon over cocktail.
wiki.art.techniques.salt-air-foam.when: Margarita salt air. Salted Negroni. Fine mezcal cocktails.
wiki.art.techniques.salt-air-foam.tips: Powdered soy lecithin (~$20). Foam lasts 30-60 min. Modernist Cuisine reference.
wiki.art.techniques.carbonation-soda-str: SodaStream and similar carbonate liquids at home with CO₂ cartridge. Accessible vs professional equipment.
Fill SodaStream bottle with liquid (cocktail, water). Charge CO₂ 1-3 pulses. Refrigerate.
Home spritz cocktails. Carbonated batched drinks. Custom soda.
Limited to 1-2 bar pressure. Professional needs iSi or kegerator. But accessible and agile.
wiki.art.techniques.carbonation-iSi.desc: iSi Whip + N₂O cartridge for professional carbonation or foam. Versatile for bar service.
wiki.art.techniques.carbonation-iSi.how: iSi siphon 0.5L. Fill with liquid. Charge N₂O cartridge. Shake. Pulse delivery.
wiki.art.techniques.carbonation-iSi.when: Nitro cocktails. Foam delivery. Carbonated specialty drinks.
wiki.art.techniques.carbonation-iSi.tips: iSi Whip $80, N₂O cartridges 50¢ each. Professional bar repository.
wiki.art.techniques.freezing-glass.title: Freezing glass
wiki.art.techniques.freezing-glass.descr: Pre-frozen glass (frosted) keeps cocktail very cold longer. Visual + functional. Standard premium service.
wiki.art.techniques.freezing-glass.how: Coupe/Martini glass in freezer 30+ min before service. Take out at serving moment.
wiki.art.techniques.freezing-glass.when: Dry Martini. Daiquiri up. Manhattan up. Any premium cocktail.
wiki.art.techniques.freezing-glass.tips: Frosted exterior is quality signal. Thick glass better — retains cold longer.
wiki.art.techniques.channel-cut.title: Channel cut
wiki.art.techniques.channel-cut.descript: Channel cut creates fine citrus twist with channel knife. Classic twist for Old Fashioned, Manhattan.
wiki.art.techniques.channel-cut.how: Channel knife over orange/lemon peel. Rotate fruit slowly. Result: 2-3mm spiral twist.
wiki.art.techniques.channel-cut.when: Old Fashioned. Manhattan. Vesper Martini. Premium classic cocktails.
wiki.art.techniques.channel-cut.tips: Economic channel knife ($10-15). Practice before service. Signature oil twist.
wiki.art.techniques.spiral-peel.title: Spiral peel
wiki.art.techniques.spiral-peel.descript: Spiral peel is long twist (10-15cm) of citrus peel. Dramatic visual in glass.
wiki.art.techniques.spiral-peel.how: Vegetable peeler + citrus. Peel in continuous spiral. 10-15cm length.
wiki.art.techniques.spiral-peel.when: Horse's Neck cocktail. Decorative service. Long drink glass.
wiki.art.techniques.spiral-peel.tips: No white pith. Firm citrus (lemon, orange). Visual key.
wiki.art.techniques.horse-neck-twist.des: Horse's Neck twist is spiral lemon peel in Horse's Neck cocktail. Covers entire highball glass interior like horse's collar.
wiki.art.techniques.horse-neck-twist.how: Peel whole lemon in spiral. Place in glass covering edge. Fill with cocktail.
wiki.art.techniques.horse-neck-twist.whe: Horse's Neck cocktail (cognac + ginger ale + bitters + spiral lemon). Decorative cocktails.
wiki.art.techniques.horse-neck-twist.tip: Firm lemon. Spiral must be continuous. Hangs from glass for visual.
wiki.art.techniques.horse-neck-twist.sou: Wondrich, Imbibe!. Difford's Guide — Horse's Neck.
wiki.art.techniques.liquid-nitrogen-sphe: Frozen cocktail spheres in liquid nitrogen (-196°C). Instant frozen bites. Aviary technique.
Cocktail + alginate + calcium gluconate. Sphere dropped in liquid N₂. Instant frozen. Served with tongs.
Aviary tasting menu. Modernist cocktail experiences. Bar laboratory shows.
Liquid N₂ dangerous (-196°C). Equipment + training necessary. Aviary masters the technique.
wiki.art.techniques.espuma.title: Espuma
wiki.art.techniques.espuma.description: Espuma = aerated foam from iSi siphon. Light texture + flavored. Over cocktail or as ingredient.
wiki.art.techniques.espuma.how: iSi siphon + liquid + stabilizer (gelatin, lecithin). Charge N₂O. Pulse foam.
wiki.art.techniques.espuma.when: Margarita espuma. Coffee espuma. Modern cocktail garnish.
wiki.art.techniques.espuma.tips: Stabilizer key — without it foam collapses. Gelatin (0.5%) ideal.
wiki.art.techniques.demi-sec-vermouth-pr: Demi-sec vermouth is 50:50 dry + sweet vermouth blend. Customization for medium Manhattan, Negroni.
In container: 1 part dry + 1 part sweet vermouth. Mix. Use in cocktails as single vermouth.
Perfect Manhattan. Medium-vermouth Negroni. Custom cocktails.
Refrigerate after making. Use within 4-6 weeks (vermouth oxidizes).
wiki.art.techniques.snow-cone-build.desc: Snow cone build is cocktail service over crushed/shaved ice mountain. Mint Julep, Tiki cocktails.
wiki.art.techniques.snow-cone-build.how: Load glass with crushed ice piled high (3-5cm over rim). Pour cocktail over. Build additional ice.
wiki.art.techniques.snow-cone-build.when: Mint Julep. Mai Tai. Zombie. Tiki snow drinks.
wiki.art.techniques.snow-cone-build.tips: Crushed ice or pebble ice. Appropriate glass (julep cup, Tiki mug). Abundant garnish.
wiki.art.techniques.double-strain-fine.d: Double strain = Hawthorne strainer + fine mesh strainer (tea strainer). Removes small fragments (herbs, pulp, ice).
wiki.art.techniques.double-strain-fine.h: Hawthorne over shaker. Tea strainer over glass. Strain cocktail through both.
wiki.art.techniques.double-strain-fine.w: Cocktails with muddled mint (fragments). Berry cocktails. Smashed herb cocktails.
wiki.art.techniques.double-strain-fine.t: Cheap tea strainer ($5). Extends foam and aroma duration.
wiki.art.tools.shaker-boston.title: Boston shaker
wiki.art.tools.shaker-boston.description: 2-piece shaker (tin+tin or tin+glass). US professional standard.
wiki.art.tools.shaker-boston.use: Citrus, dairy, egg cocktails. Tight seal, firm shake.
wiki.art.tools.shaker-boston.tips: Tin-on-tin lighter, better control. Firm tap to seal.
wiki.art.tools.shaker-cobbler.title: Cobbler shaker
wiki.art.tools.shaker-cobbler.descriptio: 3-piece shaker with built-in strainer. Iconic retro visual.
wiki.art.tools.shaker-cobbler.tips: Built-in strainer can clog — limits versatility.
wiki.art.tools.shaker-french.title: French shaker
wiki.art.tools.shaker-french.description: French 2-piece shaker no glass — tin + smaller tin. More visually elegant.
wiki.art.tools.shaker-parisian.title: Parisian shaker
wiki.art.tools.shaker-parisian.descripti: French shaker variant with characteristic curve. Less common than Boston.
wiki.art.tools.shaker-tin-on-tin.title: Tin-on-tin shaker
wiki.art.tools.shaker-tin-on-tin.descrip: Boston shaker with two tins (no glass). Lighter, easier tight seal.
wiki.art.tools.shaker-tin-on-glass.title: Tin-on-glass shaker
wiki.art.tools.shaker-tin-on-glass.descr: Original Boston: tin + pint glass. Glass shows the cocktail.
wiki.art.tools.shaker-tin-on-glass.tips: Fragile glass — careful sealing. Heavier than tin-on-tin.
wiki.art.tools.jigger-japanese.title: Japanese jigger
wiki.art.tools.jigger-japanese.descripti: Japanese jigger with internal marks for 5, 10, 15, 20, 30, 45, 60ml. Precision.
wiki.art.tools.jigger-japanese.tips: Internal marks more precise. Perfectionist look.
wiki.art.tools.jigger-bell.title: Bell jigger
wiki.art.tools.jigger-bell.description: Bell-shaped curved body jigger. Easier to pour.
wiki.art.tools.jigger-double-cone.title: Double-cone jigger
wiki.art.tools.jigger-double-cone.descri: Classic jigger with two opposed cones (1oz + 1/2oz typically). Western standard.
wiki.art.tools.jigger-double-cone.tips: 1.5oz + 0.75oz cones are standard. Limited internal marks.
wiki.art.tools.jigger-thimble.title: Thimble jigger
wiki.art.tools.jigger-thimble.tips: Limited, outdated. Not used in modern bartending.
wiki.art.tools.jigger-stepped.title: Stepped jigger
wiki.art.tools.jigger-stepped.descriptio: Jigger with visible exterior stepped milliliter marks.
wiki.art.tools.jigger-stepped.tips: Faster than Japanese but less precise.
wiki.art.tools.strainer-hawthorne.title: Hawthorne strainer
wiki.art.tools.strainer-hawthorne.descri: Spring strainer that adapts to shaker. Retains ice and particles.
wiki.art.tools.strainer-hawthorne.tips: Essential piece. Spring must be firm.
wiki.art.tools.strainer-julep.title: Julep strainer
wiki.art.tools.strainer-julep.descriptio: Large perforated spoon-style strainer. For mixing glass.
wiki.art.tools.strainer-julep.tips: Origin of stirred cocktails. Directly on mixing glass.
wiki.art.tools.strainer-fine-mesh.title: Fine mesh strainer
wiki.art.tools.mixing-glass-yarai.title: Yarai mixing glass
wiki.art.tools.mixing-glass-yarai.descri: Hand-cut Japanese mixing glass. Yarai (criss-cross) pattern. Premium.
wiki.art.tools.mixing-glass-japanese.des: Japanese precision crystal mixing glass. Variants: yarai, hira, ichi.
wiki.art.tools.mixing-glass-japanese.tip: Usuyaki Kuroko, Ginza Crystal — premium brands.
Cut crystal mixing glass. More decorative than functional.
wiki.art.tools.bar-spoon-trident.title: Trident bar spoon
wiki.art.tools.bar-spoon-trident.descrip: Bar spoon with trident-style end (3 prongs). Useful for light muddling and garnish pick.
wiki.art.tools.bar-spoon-twisted.title: Twisted bar spoon
wiki.art.tools.bar-spoon-twisted.descrip: Bar spoon with twisted/spiral shaft. Classic Japanese design. 30-45cm length.
wiki.art.tools.bar-spoon-twisted.use: Perfect stirring — twisted shaft allows easy finger spinning.
wiki.art.tools.bar-spoon-flat.title: Flat bar spoon
wiki.art.tools.bar-spoon-flat.descriptio: Bar spoon with disc on one end. Useful for layering cocktails over the disc.
wiki.art.tools.bar-spoon-european.title: European bar spoon
wiki.art.tools.bar-spoon-european.descri: Longer European bar spoon (45-55cm). For tall mixing glasses.
wiki.art.tools.bar-spoon-european.use: Premium stirring in tall mixing glass.
wiki.art.tools.muddler-wooden.title: Wooden muddler
wiki.art.tools.muddler-wooden.descriptio: Classic wooden muddler (oak, cherry). Gentle on herbs, doesn't damage glass.
wiki.art.tools.muddler-wooden.use: Muddle mint, herbs, fruit. Mojito, Mint Julep.
wiki.art.tools.muddler-wooden.tips: Waxed for waterproofing. Don't use with citrus due to absorption.
wiki.art.tools.muddler-stainless.title: Stainless muddler
wiki.art.tools.muddler-stainless.tips: Versatile. Better for professional service with citrus.
wiki.art.tools.muddler-modern-tooth.desc: Modern muddler with teeth/prongs on head for greater extraction.
wiki.art.tools.muddler-modern-tooth.use: Quick and max extraction. Aggressive muddle.
wiki.art.tools.muddler-modern-tooth.tips: Don't use with delicate herbs — breaks too much.
wiki.art.tools.citrus-press-mexican.desc: Inverted 'Mexican elbow' citrus press. Professional standard for lime.
wiki.art.tools.citrus-press-mexican.use: Fresh lime for Margarita, Daiquiri, Mojito.
wiki.art.tools.citrus-press-mexican.tips: Yellow = lime. Orange = orange. Green = lemon.
wiki.art.tools.citrus-press-electric.des: Electric citrus press for volume. Party bartender or batch.
wiki.art.tools.citrus-press-electric.tip: Hamilton Beach, Cuisinart versions. Useful for 50+ cocktails.
wiki.art.tools.citrus-press-italian.desc: Italian press with lever. Efficient, manual. Limonadiere style.
wiki.art.tools.citrus-press-italian.use: Italian granita. Café with lemon. Family bar.
wiki.art.tools.channel-knife.title: Channel knife
wiki.art.tools.channel-knife.description: Knife with channel to create citrus spiral twist.
wiki.art.tools.channel-knife.use: Old Fashioned, Manhattan twist. Premium garnish.
wiki.art.tools.peeler-y-peeler.title: Y-peeler
wiki.art.tools.peeler-y-peeler.descripti: Modern Y-shaped peeler. More ergonomic than straight peeler. Ideal for large citrus peels.
wiki.art.tools.peeler-y-peeler.use: Peel citrus for zest and twist.
wiki.art.tools.peeler-y-peeler.tips: Kuhn Rikon, OXO versions. Cheap and effective.
wiki.art.tools.peeler-swiss.title: Swiss peeler
wiki.art.tools.peeler-swiss.description: Original Swiss Kuhn Rikon peeler. 1947 design unchanged, legendary effectiveness.
wiki.art.tools.peeler-julienne.title: Julienne peeler
wiki.art.tools.peeler-julienne.descripti: Julienne peeler — parallel blades to create thin strips.
wiki.art.tools.peeler-julienne.tips: For creative garnish. Not for traditional zest.
wiki.art.tools.atomizer-glass.title: Glass atomizer
wiki.art.tools.atomizer-glass.descriptio: Glass atomizer with rubber bulb. Fine mister for aromatic spritz.
wiki.art.tools.atomizer-glass.use: Absinthe spritz, smoke essence, oil mist.
wiki.art.tools.atomizer-pressurized.desc: Modern spray pump atomizer. Easier to use than classic glass.
wiki.art.tools.atomizer-pressurized.tips: Plastic vs metal — plastic lighter. Easy refill.
wiki.art.tools.smoker-gun.title: Smoking gun
wiki.art.tools.smoker-gun.description: Gun for adding aromatic smoke to cocktail. Breville/PolyScience versions.
wiki.art.tools.smoker-gun.tips: Breville Smoking Gun ($100). Wood chips variety.
wiki.art.tools.dehydrator-home.title: Home dehydrator
wiki.art.tools.dehydrator-home.descripti: Dehydrator to create dehydrated citrus, fruit garnish, dried herbs.
wiki.art.tools.vacuum-sealer-chamber.des: Professional vacuum chamber for vacuum infusion. More powerful than FoodSaver edge sealer.
wiki.art.tools.kitchen-scale-precision.d: Precision scale 0.01g for tinctures, bitters, exact syrup making.
wiki.art.tools.refractometer.title: Refractometer
wiki.art.tools.refractometer.description: Measures Brix (sugar content) of syrups, juice, cocktails. Essential for cocktail science.
wiki.art.tools.refractometer.tips: $30-100. Only 1-2 drops per measurement. Calibrate water = 0 Brix.
wiki.art.tools.ph-meter.title: pH meter
wiki.art.tools.ph-meter.description: Measures pH of cocktails, citrus, vinegar. Crucial for cocktail balance.
wiki.art.tools.ph-meter.use: Verify pH 3.2-3.8 ideal for sour cocktails.
wiki.art.tools.ph-meter.tips: $50-200. Hanna Instruments standard. Calibrate buffer solutions.
wiki.art.tools.thermometer-laser.title: Laser thermometer
wiki.art.tools.thermometer-laser.descrip: Laser/infrared to measure temp of glass, drink, ingredients without contact.
wiki.art.tools.thermometer-laser.tips: Etekcity, ThermoPro $20-50. Useful for frozen Martini check.
wiki.art.tools.thermometer-probe.title: Probe thermometer
wiki.art.tools.thermometer-probe.descrip: Probe thermometer for direct liquid contact. More precise than laser.
wiki.art.tools.thermometer-probe.use: Sous-vide infusions. Hot toddy. Temperature control.
wiki.art.tools.iSi-whipper.title: iSi Whipper
wiki.art.tools.iSi-whipper.description: Professional iSi Whip siphon with N₂O cartridges. Versatile foam and rapid infusion.
wiki.art.tools.iSi-whipper.use: Rapid infusion. Foam delivery. Nitro carbonation.
wiki.art.tools.soda-stream.title: SodaStream
wiki.art.tools.soda-stream.description: SodaStream and similar for home carbonation. Reusable CO₂ cartridges.
wiki.art.tools.draft-tower-home.title: Home draft tower
wiki.art.tools.draft-tower-home.descript: Home draft tower (kegerator) to serve cocktails on tap. Professional batched delivery.
wiki.art.tools.draft-tower-home.use: Batched cocktails at events. Premium home bars.
wiki.art.tools.ice-mold-spheres.title: Ice sphere mold
wiki.art.tools.ice-mold-spheres.descript: Silicone mold to create 5cm ice balls. Slow melting for premium Old Fashioned.
wiki.art.tools.ice-mold-cubes-large.desc: Silicone mold for large 5cm × 5cm ice cubes. Slow dilution.
wiki.art.tools.ice-mold-collins.title: Collins ice mold
wiki.art.tools.ice-mold-collins.descript: Silicone mold for elongated cubes (10cm × 2cm). For highball/collins glass.
wiki.art.tools.ice-mold-collins.tips: Elegant shape. Longitudinal cubes in tall glass.
wiki.art.tools.ice-tongs.title: Ice tongs
wiki.art.tools.ice-tongs.description: Tongs for hygienic ice service. Professional bartender standard.
wiki.art.tools.ice-tongs.use: Bar service. Individual ice cube pickup.
wiki.art.tools.bottle-pourers.title: Bottle pourers
wiki.art.tools.bottle-pourers.descriptio: Spouts inserted in bottles for pour control and measure.
wiki.art.tools.bottle-pourers.use: Quick service. Pre-batched cocktails. Speed rail.
wiki.art.tools.bottle-pourers.tips: Free flow vs measured (15, 20, 30ml). Plastic vs metal.
wiki.art.tools.speed-pourers.title: Speed pourers
wiki.art.tools.speed-pourers.description: Free-flow pourers for bartender speed service. Free flow combat.
wiki.art.tools.speed-rail.title: Speed rail
wiki.art.tools.speed-rail.description: Speed rail = bottle holder under bar. Quick access to well spirits.
wiki.art.tools.speed-rail.tips: Layout key — most used at front.
wiki.art.tools.garnish-pick-metal.title: Metal garnish pick
wiki.art.tools.garnish-pick-metal.descri: Metal picks for garnish — sustainable and elegant. Retro and modern versions.
wiki.art.tools.garnish-pick-bamboo.title: Bamboo garnish pick
wiki.art.tools.garnish-pick-bamboo.descr: Eco-friendly disposable bamboo picks. Sustainable plastic alternative.
wiki.art.tools.coupe-glass-deep.title: Deep coupe glass
wiki.art.tools.coupe-glass-deep.descript: Deep coupe glass for 6-8oz up cocktails. More modern than small coupe.
wiki.art.tools.coupe-glass-deep.tips: Riedel, Schott Zwiesel premium. Larger capacity for complex cocktails.
wiki.art.tools.coupe-glass-shallow.title: Shallow coupe glass
wiki.art.tools.coupe-glass-shallow.descr: Classic 4-5oz coupe glass. 1920s-50s vintage style. Elegant service.
wiki.art.tools.coupe-glass-shallow.tips: Vintage signature visual. Limited capacity — not for large cocktails.
wiki.art.mixers.bitters-aromatic.title: Aromatic bitters
wiki.art.mixers.bitters-aromatic.descrip: Aromatic bitters like Angostura — spice, herb, gentian base. 44.7% ABV. Originated 1824 Venezuela by Dr. Siegert.
wiki.art.mixers.bitters-aromatic.use: Old Fashioned, Manhattan, Sazerac. Standard 2-3 dashes.
wiki.art.mixers.bitters-aromatic.charact: Cinnamon, clove, gentian, sweet spice notes.
wiki.art.mixers.bitters-aromatic.tips: Angostura is essential. Premium: Bittermens, Bittercube.
wiki.art.mixers.bitters-orange.title: Orange bitters
wiki.art.mixers.bitters-orange.descripti: Orange bitters from bitter orange peel. Originally pre-Prohibition essential ingredient.
wiki.art.mixers.bitters-orange.use: Original Martini (gin + dry vermouth + orange bitters). Complex Manhattan.
wiki.art.mixers.bitters-orange.tips: Regan's #6, Fee Brothers. Essential pre-Prohibition cocktails.
wiki.art.mixers.bitters-peychaud.title: Peychaud's bitters
wiki.art.mixers.bitters-peychaud.descrip: Peychaud's bitters of anise + cherry + gentian. Created 1830 New Orleans by Antoine Peychaud.
wiki.art.mixers.bitters-creole.title: Creole bitters
wiki.art.mixers.bitters-creole.descripti: Creole NOLA bitters with pimento, allspice, cayenne. Spicier than Peychaud.
wiki.art.mixers.bitters-mole.title: Mole bitters
wiki.art.mixers.bitters-mole.description: Mole bitters inspired by Mexican mole sauce. Cocoa + spices + chili.
wiki.art.mixers.bitters-mole.use: Mezcal Old Fashioned. Oaxaca Old Fashioned. Mexican cocktails.
wiki.art.mixers.bitters-celery.title: Celery bitters
wiki.art.mixers.bitters-celery.descripti: Celery bitters from fresh celery. Adds savory vegetal to cocktails.
wiki.art.mixers.bitters-celery.tips: The Bitter Truth Celery. For Bloody Mary and vodka cocktails.
wiki.art.mixers.bitters-cardamom.title: Cardamom bitters
wiki.art.mixers.bitters-cardamom.use: Gin cocktails. Aged rum drinks. Modern signature.
wiki.art.mixers.bitters-chocolate.title: Chocolate bitters
wiki.art.mixers.bitters-chocolate.descri: Chocolate bitters from cocoa beans + bitter herbs. Dessert profile.
wiki.art.mixers.bitters-chocolate.use: Aged Old Fashioned. Mocha cocktails. After-dinner.
wiki.art.mixers.bitters-rhubarb.title: Rhubarb bitters
wiki.art.mixers.bitters-rhubarb.descript: Rhubarb bitters with tart-sweet rhubarb notes.
wiki.art.mixers.bitters-rhubarb.use: Gin Negroni variant. Spring cocktails. Aperitivo.
wiki.art.mixers.bitters-grapefruit.title: Grapefruit bitters
wiki.art.mixers.bitters-grapefruit.descr: Grapefruit bitters from peel and oils. Bright, fresh.
wiki.art.mixers.bitters-lavender.title: Lavender bitters
wiki.art.mixers.bitters-lavender.descrip: Lavender bitters from lavender flowers. Floral, herbaceous.
wiki.art.mixers.bitters-lavender.use: Floral gin cocktails. Spring Negroni. Aperitivo.
wiki.art.mixers.bitters-cherry.title: Cherry bitters
wiki.art.mixers.bitters-cherry.descripti: Cherry bitters from macerated cherries. Fruity, almond hint.
wiki.art.mixers.bitters-cherry.use: Manhattan variant. Bourbon Old Fashioned. Modern Manhattan.
wiki.art.mixers.bitters-cherry.tips: The Bitter Truth Cherry. Pairs well with bourbon.
wiki.art.mixers.bitters-walnut.title: Walnut bitters
wiki.art.mixers.bitters-walnut.descripti: Walnut bitters from walnuts + maple + bitter herbs. Autumnal.
wiki.art.mixers.bitters-walnut.use: Whiskey cocktails. Fall Old Fashioned. Holiday.
wiki.art.mixers.bitters-walnut.tips: Fee Brothers Black Walnut. Trace dose.
wiki.art.mixers.bitters-tiki.title: Tiki bitters
wiki.art.mixers.bitters-tiki.description: Tiki bitters with tropical spices (clove, allspice, nutmeg, cinnamon).
wiki.art.mixers.bitters-tiki.use: Mai Tai, Painkiller, Tiki cocktails. Spice complexity.
wiki.art.mixers.bitters-tiki.tips: Bittermens Tiki Bitters. Essential for Tiki signature.
wiki.art.mixers.simple-syrup.title: Simple syrup
wiki.art.mixers.simple-syrup.description: Simple syrup = 1 part sugar + 1 part water. 30 Brix. Base of all sour cocktails.
wiki.art.mixers.simple-syrup.tips: Refrigerate after making. 2-4 week shelf life.
wiki.art.mixers.demerara-syrup.title: Demerara syrup
wiki.art.mixers.demerara-syrup.descripti: Demerara syrup from demerara brown sugar. Toffee, caramel notes.
wiki.art.mixers.demerara-syrup.use: Old Fashioned. Tiki cocktails. Rum drinks.
wiki.art.mixers.honey-syrup.title: Honey syrup
wiki.art.mixers.honey-syrup.description: Honey syrup = 1 part honey + 1 part hot water. Diluted for easy mixology.
wiki.art.mixers.honey-syrup.use: Penicillin (Sam Ross). Bee's Knees. Honey-forward cocktails.
wiki.art.mixers.honey-syrup.tips: Raw honey better. Dissolve in hot water. Refrigerate.
wiki.art.mixers.agave-syrup.title: Agave syrup
wiki.art.mixers.agave-syrup.description: Mexican natural agave syrup. Sweeter than simple, lower glycemic index.
wiki.art.mixers.agave-syrup.use: Authentic Margarita. Mezcal cocktails. Tequila drinks.
wiki.art.mixers.agave-syrup.tips: Agave nectar more liquid than syrup. Trace for sweeter perception.
wiki.art.mixers.ginger-syrup.title: Ginger syrup
wiki.art.mixers.ginger-syrup.description: Ginger syrup from fresh ginger + sugar. Spicy, refreshing.
wiki.art.mixers.ginger-syrup.use: Penicillin. Moscow Mule. Homemade ginger cocktails.
wiki.art.mixers.ginger-syrup.tips: Fresh grated ginger in simple syrup. Boil 5 min.
wiki.art.mixers.orgeat.title: Orgeat
wiki.art.mixers.orgeat.description: Orgeat syrup from almonds + orange flower + spices. Mai Tai temple.
wiki.art.mixers.orgeat.use: Mai Tai (signature). Tiki cocktails. Almond-forward drinks.
wiki.art.mixers.orgeat.tips: Small Hand Foods Orgeat is premium. Homemade accessible with almonds + simple.
wiki.art.mixers.falernum.title: Falernum
wiki.art.mixers.falernum.description: Caribbean falernum with lime, clove, almond, ginger, rum. Spicy-sweet.
wiki.art.mixers.falernum.use: Tiki cocktails. Three Dots and a Dash. Falernum Daiquiri.
wiki.art.mixers.falernum.tips: John D. Taylor's Velvet Falernum is standard. Homemade complex.
wiki.art.mixers.grenadine-real.title: Real grenadine
wiki.art.mixers.grenadine-real.descripti: Real grenadine from pomegranate juice + simple syrup. Different from industrial Rose's.
wiki.art.mixers.grenadine-real.use: Tequila Sunrise. Jack Rose. Pink Lady.
wiki.art.mixers.grenadine-real.tips: POM Wonderful juice + simple is excellent homemade. Rose's is high-fructose corn syrup, avoid.
wiki.art.mixers.raspberry-syrup.title: Raspberry syrup
wiki.art.mixers.raspberry-syrup.descript: Raspberry syrup from raspberries + sugar. Fresh, vibrant berry.
wiki.art.mixers.raspberry-syrup.use: Clover Club. Raspberry Daiquiri. Berry cocktails.
wiki.art.mixers.raspberry-syrup.tips: Frozen raspberries + simple syrup, boil 5 min.
wiki.art.mixers.mint-syrup.title: Mint syrup
wiki.art.mixers.mint-syrup.description: Mint syrup from fresh mint leaves + simple. Adds mint without muddling.
wiki.art.mixers.mint-syrup.use: Alternative Mojito. Homemade Mint Julep. Modern cocktails without fresh mint.
wiki.art.mixers.mint-syrup.tips: Fresh leaves in simple syrup, 1h infusion. Strain immediately.
wiki.art.mixers.rosemary-syrup.title: Rosemary syrup
wiki.art.mixers.rosemary-syrup.descripti: Rosemary syrup from fresh rosemary + simple. Pine, herbal notes.
wiki.art.mixers.rosemary-syrup.use: Gin cocktails. Whiskey rosemary. Modern signature.
wiki.art.mixers.rosemary-syrup.tips: Fresh sprig in simple syrup, 30 min infusion.
wiki.art.mixers.lavender-syrup.title: Lavender syrup
wiki.art.mixers.lavender-syrup.descripti: Lavender syrup from dried lavender flowers + simple. Elegant floral.
wiki.art.mixers.lavender-syrup.use: Floral gin. Spring cocktails. Lavender lemonade.
wiki.art.mixers.lavender-syrup.tips: Food-grade lavender. Don't use ornamental (can be toxic).
wiki.art.mixers.vanilla-syrup.title: Vanilla syrup
wiki.art.mixers.vanilla-syrup.descriptio: Vanilla syrup from split vanilla pods + simple. Warm, dessert.
wiki.art.mixers.vanilla-syrup.use: Espresso Martini. Vanilla whiskey. Cream cocktails.
wiki.art.mixers.maple-syrup.title: Maple syrup
wiki.art.mixers.maple-syrup.description: Canadian maple syrup. Simple syrup substitute in whiskey cocktails.
wiki.art.mixers.maple-syrup.use: Whiskey Old Fashioned. Maple-bourbon Manhattan. Fall cocktails.
wiki.art.mixers.maple-syrup.tips: Grade A Dark Robust best for cocktails. Canadian premium.
wiki.art.mixers.cinnamon-syrup.title: Cinnamon syrup
wiki.art.mixers.cinnamon-syrup.descripti: Cinnamon syrup from cinnamon sticks + simple. Holiday cocktails.
wiki.art.mixers.cinnamon-syrup.use: Hot Toddy. Sazerac variant. Eggnog. Winter cocktails.
wiki.art.mixers.cinnamon-syrup.tips: Vietnam/Ceylon cinnamon best. 30 min boil infusion.
wiki.art.mixers.tonic-water-history.desc: Tonic water originally 19th-century medicinal (quinine for malaria). Commercially since 1858 (Schweppes).
wiki.art.mixers.tonic-water-history.tips: Original Schweppes. Today craft tonic boom.
wiki.art.mixers.tonic-water-craft.title: Craft tonic water
wiki.art.mixers.tonic-water-craft.descri: Craft tonic water (Fever-Tree, Fentimans, Q) with natural quinine and real citrus. 2010s boom.
wiki.art.mixers.tonic-water-craft.charac: Balanced quinine, real citrus, less sweet.
wiki.art.mixers.tonic-water-craft.tips: Fever-Tree Mediterranean for floral gins. Fentimans Pink Grapefruit for complexity.
wiki.art.mixers.soda-water.title: Soda water
wiki.art.mixers.ginger-beer.title: Ginger beer
wiki.art.mixers.ginger-beer.use: Moscow Mule. Dark and Stormy. Mule family.
wiki.art.mixers.ginger-ale.title: Ginger ale
wiki.art.mixers.ginger-ale.description: Ginger ale = soda with mild ginger flavor. Less spicy than ginger beer. Mainstream.
wiki.art.mixers.ginger-ale.use: Whisky highball. Cuban Manhattan. Casual cocktails.
wiki.art.mixers.ginger-ale.tips: Canada Dry standard. DON'T use for Mule (need ginger beer).
wiki.art.mixers.club-soda.title: Club soda
wiki.art.mixers.club-soda.description: Club soda = soda water + added minerals (sodium bicarbonate, citrate). More mineral than pure soda.
wiki.art.mixers.club-soda.use: Cocktails needing mineral mouthfeel. Whisky club soda.
wiki.art.mixers.club-soda.tips: Classic brand White Rock. Different from seltzer (no minerals).
wiki.art.mixers.seltzer.title: Seltzer
wiki.art.mixers.seltzer.description: Seltzer = water + CO₂ no added minerals. Neutral.
wiki.art.mixers.sparkling-mineral.title: Sparkling mineral water
wiki.art.mixers.sparkling-mineral.descri: Sparkling mineral water (San Pellegrino, Perrier) with natural CO₂. Specific mineral content.
wiki.art.mixers.sparkling-mineral.use: Premium cocktails focusing on mouthfeel. Premium G&T.
wiki.art.mixers.sparkling-mineral.tips: Perrier less bubbles, S. Pellegrino more bubbles. Premium G&T.
wiki.art.mixers.sparkling-grapefruit.des: Sparkling grapefruit soda (Squirt, Ting, Fresca) with grapefruit juice + CO₂.
wiki.art.mixers.sparkling-grapefruit.use: Paloma. Modern Italian cocktails. Refreshing aperitivo.
wiki.art.mixers.sparkling-grapefruit.tip: Ting (Jamaican) premium version for Paloma. Squirt mainstream USA version.
wiki.art.mixers.vermouth-dry.title: Dry vermouth
wiki.art.mixers.vermouth-dry.description: French dry vermouth (Noilly Prat, Dolin Dry). 18% ABV. Alpine herbs + oxidative white wine.
wiki.art.mixers.vermouth-dry.tips: Refrigerate after opening. 4-6 week shelf life. Don't use after.
wiki.art.mixers.vermouth-sweet.title: Sweet vermouth
wiki.art.mixers.vermouth-sweet.descripti: Italian sweet vermouth (Carpano Antica, Cinzano Rosso). 15-17% ABV. Herbs + caramel + red wine.
wiki.art.mixers.vermouth-sweet.tips: Refrigerate after opening. Carpano Antica premium, Cinzano standard.
wiki.art.mixers.sherry-cooking.title: Sherry for mixology
wiki.art.mixers.sherry-cooking.descripti: Spanish sherry used in cocktails — Fino (dry), Manzanilla (saline), Amontillado (nutty), Oloroso (rich).
wiki.art.mixers.sherry-cooking.use: Sherry Cobbler. Bamboo. Adonis. Modern sherry cocktails.
wiki.art.mixers.sherry-cooking.tips: Refrigerate Fino/Manzanilla after opening (oxidize fast). Oloroso more stable.
wiki.art.mixers.dry-curacao.title: Dry curaçao
wiki.art.mixers.dry-curacao.description: Premium dry curaçao like Pierre Ferrand (40% ABV). More complex and dry than triple sec.
wiki.art.mixers.dry-curacao.use: Premium Sidecar. Premium Margarita. Mai Tai (Ferrand version).
wiki.art.mixers.dry-curacao.tips: Pierre Ferrand Dry Curaçao is modern standard. Better than Cointreau in some recipes.
wiki.art.mixers.blue-curacao.title: Blue curaçao
wiki.art.mixers.blue-curacao.description: Blue curaçao with blue coloring. Signature visual for party cocktails.
wiki.art.mixers.blue-curacao.use: Blue Hawaiian. Blue Lagoon. Visual cocktails.
wiki.art.mixers.blue-curacao.tips: Marie Brizard, Bols Blue Curaçao. For visual, not flavor.
wiki.art.mixers.triple-sec.title: Triple sec
wiki.art.mixers.triple-sec.description: Generic triple sec (30-40% ABV). Orange liqueur standard. Cointreau is premium version.
wiki.art.mixers.triple-sec.use: Standard Margarita. Sidecar. Long Island Iced Tea.
wiki.art.mixers.triple-sec.tips: Cointreau premium $40, generic triple sec $15. Notable difference.
wiki.art.mixers.egg-white.title: Egg white
wiki.art.mixers.egg-white.description: Fresh egg white. Serum albumin forms stable foam in sour cocktails.
wiki.art.mixers.egg-white.use: Whiskey Sour. Pisco Sour. Ramos Gin Fizz. Clover Club.
wiki.art.mixers.egg-white.tips: Always fresh egg. Dry shake key. ~30ml per egg white.
wiki.art.mixers.aquafaba-substitute.desc: Aquafaba (cooked chickpea liquid) = vegan egg white substitute. Identical foam.
wiki.art.mixers.aquafaba-substitute.use: Vegan Whiskey Sour. Vegan Pisco Sour. Vegan cocktails.
wiki.art.mixers.aquafaba-substitute.char: No flavor, identical foam to egg white.
wiki.art.mixers.aquafaba-substitute.tips: 60ml = 1 egg white. Buy chickpeas in water (not brine).
wiki.art.mixers.gum-syrup.title: Gum syrup
wiki.art.mixers.gum-syrup.description: Gum syrup (gomme syrup) = simple syrup + gum arabic. Mucilaginous texture, premium mouthfeel.
wiki.art.mixers.gum-syrup.use: Pre-Prohibition cocktails. Mint Julep. Foam cocktails.
wiki.art.mixers.gum-syrup.tips: Small Hand Foods Gomme Syrup. Homemade with gum arabic powder.
wiki.art.mixers.horchata.title: Horchata
wiki.art.mixers.horchata.description: Mexican horchata = rice + cinnamon + vanilla + sugar. Non-alcoholic, creamy.
wiki.art.mixers.horchata.tips: Spanish chufa version different. Mexican standard rice.
wiki.art.mixers.tamarind-syrup.title: Tamarind syrup
wiki.art.mixers.tamarind-syrup.descripti: Tamarind syrup from tamarind pulp + simple syrup. Exotic sour-sweet.
wiki.art.mixers.tamarind-syrup.use: Indian cocktails. Mexican margaritas. Modern signature.
wiki.art.mixers.tamarind-syrup.tips: Frozen tamarind pulp at Asian/Mexican supermarket.
wiki.art.mixers.passion-fruit-puree.desc: Passion fruit pulp puree. Sweet-tart, tropical signature.
wiki.art.mixers.passion-fruit-puree.use: Pornstar Martini. Passion fruit Margarita. Tropical cocktails.
wiki.art.mixers.passion-fruit-puree.tips: Boiron, Funkin frozen purees. Fresh hard outside tropical.
wiki.art.mixers.lime-cordial.title: Lime cordial
wiki.art.mixers.lime-cordial.description: English lime cordial (Rose's) or homemade. Cooked lime juice + sugar. Stabilized.
wiki.art.mixers.lime-cordial.use: Gimlet. Classic British cocktails. Cocktails without fresh lime.
wiki.art.mixers.lime-cordial.tips: Rose's industrial vs homemade — homemade superior. Long shelf life (2-4 weeks).
wiki.art.mixers.lemon-cordial.title: Lemon cordial
wiki.art.mixers.lemon-cordial.descriptio: Homemade lemon cordial. Cooked lemon juice + zest + sugar. Stabilized.
wiki.art.mixers.lemon-cordial.use: Lemon cocktails needing stability. Bottled cocktails.
wiki.art.mixers.lemon-cordial.tips: Homemade key — Rose's doesn't have mainstream lemon version.
wiki.art.mixers.rosewater.title: Rosewater
wiki.art.mixers.rosewater.description: Rosewater = rose petal distillate. Mediterranean/Persian traditional. Intense floral.
wiki.art.mixers.rosewater.use: Ramos Gin Fizz. Persian cocktails. Floral cocktails.
wiki.art.mixers.rosewater.tips: Short doses (1-3 drops). Mary Page, Sadaf brands.
wiki.art.mixers.orange-blossom-water.des: Orange blossom water = orange flower distillate. Mediterranean. Delicate citrus floral.
wiki.art.mixers.orange-blossom-water.use: Ramos Gin Fizz (signature). Persian cocktails. Aperitivo.
wiki.art.mixers.orange-blossom-water.tip: Essential for Ramos. 1-2 dashes — otherwise dominates.
wiki.art.mixers.kombucha-mixer.title: Kombucha mixer
wiki.art.mixers.kombucha-mixer.descripti: Kombucha (fermented tea) used as modern mixer. Probiotic, slightly carbonated.
wiki.art.mixers.kombucha-mixer.use: Low-ABV cocktails. Health-conscious bartending. Modern signature.
wiki.art.mixers.kombucha-mixer.tips: Flavored variants (ginger, lavender) versatile. Always refrigerate.
wiki.art.wines.chardonnay.title: Chardonnay
wiki.art.wines.chardonnay.description: Chardonnay is the world's most versatile white grape. Burgundy origin, today global. Varies from fresh unoaked to complex oaked.
wiki.art.wines.chardonnay.characteristic: Green apple, lemon, butter, vanilla (if oaked).
wiki.art.wines.chardonnay.tips: Unoaked = fresh acidic. Oaked = creamy buttery. Pairs perfectly seafood, creamy chicken.
wiki.art.wines.sauvignon-blanc.title: Sauvignon Blanc
wiki.art.wines.sauvignon-blanc.descripti: Sauvignon Blanc is crisp aromatic white grape. Herbaceous, citrus notes.
wiki.art.wines.sauvignon-blanc.character: Cut grass, lime, passion fruit, mineral.
wiki.art.wines.sauvignon-blanc.tips: NZ Marlborough = explosive aromatic. Sancerre Loire = elegant mineral.
wiki.art.wines.riesling.title: Riesling
wiki.art.wines.riesling.description: Riesling is noble white grape from Germany. Range from dry to sweet. Vibrant acidity.
wiki.art.wines.riesling.tips: Kabinett (dry), Spätlese (semi), Auslese (sweet). Spicy food pairing king.
wiki.art.wines.pinot-grigio.title: Pinot Grigio
wiki.art.wines.pinot-grigio.description: Italian Pinot Grigio (Pinot Gris in France). Light, fresh, easy-drinking.
wiki.art.wines.pinot-grigio.tips: Italy = light fresh. France Alsace = more complex weighty.
wiki.art.wines.viognier.title: Viognier
wiki.art.wines.viognier.description: Viognier is aromatic white grape from Rhône. Floral, peach, opulent.
wiki.art.wines.viognier.tips: Condrieu most elegant. Pairs with spicy fish, mild curry.
wiki.art.wines.semillon.title: Sémillon
wiki.art.wines.semillon.description: Sémillon is Bordeaux white grape. Alone or blended with Sauvignon Blanc. Rich, waxy.
wiki.art.wines.semillon.region: Bordeaux, Hunter Valley Australia, South Africa.
wiki.art.wines.semillon.tips: Sauternes (botrytis) is noble sweet. Hunter Valley dry is complex.
wiki.art.wines.gewurztraminer.title: Gewürztraminer
wiki.art.wines.gewurztraminer.descriptio: Gewürztraminer is intensely aromatic white grape. Lychee, rose, spice. Typically off-dry.
wiki.art.wines.gewurztraminer.characteri: Lychee, rose petal, ginger, lychee, spice.
wiki.art.wines.gewurztraminer.tips: Pairs with curry, foie gras, blue cheese. Unique, highly recognizable aromatic.
wiki.art.wines.chenin-blanc.title: Chenin Blanc
wiki.art.wines.chenin-blanc.description: Chenin Blanc is versatile Loire white grape. Dry to sweet to sparkling. Vibrant acidity.
wiki.art.wines.chenin-blanc.region: Loire Valley France (Vouvray, Savennières). South Africa.
wiki.art.wines.chenin-blanc.tips: Vouvray sec ideal aperitif. South African Chenin accessible.
wiki.art.wines.albarino.title: Albariño
wiki.art.wines.albarino.description: Albariño is aromatic Galician grape. Mineral, saline, perfect seafood pairing.
wiki.art.wines.albarino.region: Rías Baixas Galicia Spain. Vinho Verde Portugal (Alvarinho).
wiki.art.wines.albarino.tips: Pairs with Atlantic seafood. Only Galicia and Vinho Verde.
wiki.art.wines.gruner-veltliner.title: Grüner Veltliner
wiki.art.wines.gruner-veltliner.descript: Grüner Veltliner is Austrian white grape. White pepper signature, vibrant.
wiki.art.wines.gruner-veltliner.tips: Wachau Smaragd (premium) complex. Pairs perfectly with asparagus, chicken.
wiki.art.wines.muscadet.title: Muscadet
wiki.art.wines.muscadet.description: Muscadet from Melon de Bourgogne. Atlantic Loire. Dry, mineral, seafood pairing.
wiki.art.wines.muscadet.tips: Sur Lie (aged on lees) premium. Pairs with oysters.
wiki.art.wines.vermentino.title: Vermentino
wiki.art.wines.vermentino.description: Vermentino Mediterranean white grape. Sardinia, Liguria, Provence. Saline, herbal.
wiki.art.wines.vermentino.region: Sardinia Italy (Vermentino di Gallura). Liguria. Provence.
wiki.art.wines.vermentino.tips: Perfect pairs with pesto, antipasti, Mediterranean fish.
wiki.art.wines.trebbiano.title: Trebbiano
wiki.art.wines.trebbiano.description: Trebbiano mainstream Italian white grape. Neutral, fresh, accessible.
wiki.art.wines.trebbiano.tips: Base of Cognac and Armagnac (Ugni Blanc). Wine variant easy-drinking.
wiki.art.wines.verdejo.title: Verdejo
wiki.art.wines.verdejo.description: Verdejo Spanish white grape. Rueda DOC. Aromatic, herbaceous.
wiki.art.wines.verdejo.region: Rueda DOC Castilla y León Spain.
wiki.art.wines.verdejo.tips: Pairs with tapas, seafood. Marqués de Riscal Rueda standard.
wiki.art.wines.godello.title: Godello
wiki.art.wines.godello.description: Godello noble Galician white grape. Valdeorras DOC. Complex, mineral.
wiki.art.wines.godello.tips: More complex than Albariño. Aging capacity.
wiki.art.wines.torrontes.title: Torrontés
wiki.art.wines.torrontes.description: Torrontés native Argentine white grape. Intensely aromatic, semi-dry.
wiki.art.wines.torrontes.tips: Unique aromatic Argentine. Pairs with ceviche, Peruvian food.
wiki.art.wines.pinot-noir.title: Pinot Noir
wiki.art.wines.pinot-noir.description: Pinot Noir noble red grape from Burgundy. Delicate, elegant, complex aging.
wiki.art.wines.pinot-noir.region: Burgundy France. Oregon, Sonoma California, NZ.
wiki.art.wines.pinot-noir.tips: Burgundy is world reference. Oregon Willamette, Central Otago NZ premium alternatives.
wiki.art.wines.cabernet-sauvignon.title: Cabernet Sauvignon
wiki.art.wines.cabernet-sauvignon.descri: Cabernet Sauvignon noble Bordeaux red grape. Structured, tannic, aging capacity.
wiki.art.wines.cabernet-sauvignon.region: Bordeaux France. Napa USA, Chile, Australia.
wiki.art.wines.cabernet-sauvignon.tips: Napa Cabernet rich. Bordeaux Left Bank structured. 10-30 years aging.
wiki.art.wines.merlot.title: Merlot
wiki.art.wines.merlot.description: Merlot Bordeaux red grape. Softer than Cabernet, blendable, approachable.
wiki.art.wines.merlot.tips: Right Bank Bordeaux (Petrus, Cheval Blanc) premium. Avoid cheap California Merlot.
wiki.art.wines.syrah-shiraz.title: Syrah / Shiraz
wiki.art.wines.syrah-shiraz.description: Syrah (France) = Shiraz (Australia). Spicy red grape with pepper notes. Different styles per country.
wiki.art.wines.syrah-shiraz.tips: Hermitage is Old World max expression. Barossa Shiraz mainstream Australia.
wiki.art.wines.malbec.title: Malbec
wiki.art.wines.malbec.description: Malbec red grape originally French Cahors, today Argentine queen. Mendoza king product.
wiki.art.wines.malbec.region: Mendoza Argentina (Uco Valley premium). Cahors France.
wiki.art.wines.malbec.characteristics: Black cherry, plum, violet, soft tannins.
wiki.art.wines.malbec.tips: Mendoza Uco Valley premium. Pairs with grilled steak.
wiki.art.wines.tempranillo.title: Tempranillo
wiki.art.wines.tempranillo.description: Tempranillo noble Spanish red grape. Rioja, Ribera del Duero. Balanced acidity.
wiki.art.wines.tempranillo.region: Rioja, Ribera del Duero Spain. Tejo Portugal (Tinta Roriz).
wiki.art.wines.tempranillo.tips: Rioja Gran Reserva premium aging. Pairs with Iberian ham, lamb.
wiki.art.wines.sangiovese.title: Sangiovese
wiki.art.wines.sangiovese.description: Sangiovese main Tuscan red grape. Chianti, Brunello di Montalcino. Cherry signature.
wiki.art.wines.sangiovese.tips: Brunello (100% Sangiovese Grosso) premium. Chianti Classico standard.
wiki.art.wines.nebbiolo.title: Nebbiolo
wiki.art.wines.nebbiolo.description: Nebbiolo noble Piedmont red grape. Barolo, Barbaresco. Tannic, legendary aging.
wiki.art.wines.nebbiolo.characteristics: Rose, tar, cherry, firm but elegant tannins.
wiki.art.wines.nebbiolo.tips: Barolo is 'king of Italian wines'. 10-30 years aging.
wiki.art.wines.zinfandel.title: Zinfandel
wiki.art.wines.zinfandel.description: Zinfandel = Italian Primitivo. US mainstream red grape. Jammy fruit, high alcohol.
wiki.art.wines.zinfandel.characteristics: Jammy blackberry, cherry, pepper, high alcohol.
wiki.art.wines.zinfandel.tips: Old Vine Zinfandel premium. White Zinfandel different (rosé).
wiki.art.wines.gamay.title: Gamay
wiki.art.wines.gamay.description: Gamay Beaujolais red grape. Light, fruity, fresh. Beaujolais Nouveau annual campaign.
wiki.art.wines.gamay.tips: Cru Beaujolais (Fleurie, Morgon) premium. Nouveau is November novelty.
wiki.art.wines.grenache.title: Grenache
wiki.art.wines.grenache.description: Grenache = Garnacha. Mediterranean red grape. Base of Châteauneuf-du-Pape and Priorat.
wiki.art.wines.grenache.tips: Châteauneuf-du-Pape premium blend. Priorat Spanish dark intense.
wiki.art.wines.carmenere.title: Carmenère
wiki.art.wines.carmenere.description: Carmenère Bordeaux red grape almost extinct, rescued in Chile. Today Chilean signature grape.
wiki.art.wines.carmenere.characteristics: Green pepper, plum, chocolate, soft tannins.
wiki.art.wines.carmenere.tips: Confused with Merlot until 1994 (DNA test revealed). Chile produces 90% world.
wiki.art.wines.montepulciano.title: Montepulciano
wiki.art.wines.montepulciano.description: Montepulciano Italian red grape, mainly Abruzzo. Easy-drinking, accessible.
wiki.art.wines.montepulciano.region: Abruzzo, Marche Italy. NOT Tuscany (Vino Nobile de Montepulciano uses Sangiovese).
wiki.art.wines.montepulciano.tips: Confused with Vino Nobile de Montepulciano (made from Sangiovese). Italian everyday red.
wiki.art.wines.primitivo.title: Primitivo
wiki.art.wines.primitivo.description: Italian Primitivo = American Zinfandel (same DNA). Apulia. Jammy fruit, intense.
wiki.art.wines.primitivo.tips: Primitivo di Manduria DOC premium. More southern Italian than California Zinfandel.
wiki.art.wines.barbera.title: Barbera
wiki.art.wines.barbera.description: Barbera Piedmont red grape. More accessible than Nebbiolo. High acidity, soft tannins.
wiki.art.wines.barbera.characteristics: Red cherry, high acidity, modest tannins.
wiki.art.wines.barbera.tips: Pairs with tomato pasta. Barbera d'Alba more premium than Barbera d'Asti.
wiki.art.wines.dolcetto.title: Dolcetto
wiki.art.wines.dolcetto.description: Dolcetto Piedmont red grape (Dogliani, Diano d'Alba). Light, fresh, easy.
wiki.art.wines.dolcetto.tips: Dolcetto everyday Piedmont. Drink young (no aging).
wiki.art.wines.champagne-blanc-de-blancs: Champagne 100% Chardonnay (white grapes). Elegant, mineral, long aging.
Green apple, citrus, mineral, brioche with aging.
Salon, Krug Clos du Mesnil top. 10-30 years aging.
Champagne from black grapes (Pinot Noir + Meunier) without skin contact. Rich, structured.
Champagne, Montagne de Reims, Vallée de la Marne.
Bollinger Vieilles Vignes Françaises legend. Richer than Blanc de Blancs.
wiki.art.wines.champagne-rose.title: Champagne Rosé
wiki.art.wines.champagne-rose.descriptio: Rosé Champagne made with red wine added at the end (assemblage) or saignée (brief maceration).
wiki.art.wines.champagne-rose.characteri: Fresh red fruits, brioche, delicate bubbles.
wiki.art.wines.champagne-rose.tips: Billecart-Salmon Rosé iconic. Saignée more intense, assemblage more delicate.
wiki.art.wines.champagne-vintage.title: Champagne Vintage
wiki.art.wines.champagne-vintage.descrip: Vintage Champagne (millésime) from excellent single year. Min 3-year aging. Premium category.
wiki.art.wines.champagne-vintage.tips: Only declared excellence years. Dom Pérignon, Krug Vintage, Cristal.
wiki.art.wines.champagne-non-vintage.des: Non-Vintage Champagne (NV) is multi-year blend. Consistent house style.
wiki.art.wines.champagne-non-vintage.cha: Consistent house style. Brioche, citrus, mineral.
wiki.art.wines.champagne-non-vintage.tip: Veuve Clicquot Yellow Label, Moët Brut Impérial standard. NV is 80% Champagne production.
wiki.art.wines.prosecco-extra-dry.title: Prosecco Extra Dry
wiki.art.wines.prosecco-extra-dry.descri: Prosecco Extra Dry (paradoxically sweeter than Brut). 12-17g/L sugar. Signature aperitif.
wiki.art.wines.prosecco-extra-dry.tips: For Aperol Spritz. Mionetto, Bisol commercial standards.
wiki.art.wines.prosecco-brut.title: Prosecco Brut
wiki.art.wines.prosecco-brut.description: Prosecco Brut with less than 12g/L sugar. Drier. Modern preference.
wiki.art.wines.prosecco-brut.tips: For cocktails needing less sweetness. Modern Bellini variant.
wiki.art.wines.cava.title: Cava
wiki.art.wines.cava.description: Cava is Spanish sparkling wine made with traditional method (champenoise). Penedés Catalonia.
wiki.art.wines.cava.region: Penedés, Catalonia. Macabeo, Xarel·lo, Parellada grapes.
wiki.art.wines.cava.tips: Cava de Paraje Calificado premium. Freixenet, Codorníu standard.
wiki.art.wines.cremant.title: Crémant
wiki.art.wines.cremant.description: Crémant is French sparkling wine outside Champagne. Traditional method. Bargain premium.
wiki.art.wines.cremant.tips: Crémant de Limoux older than Champagne (1531). Excellent alternative.
wiki.art.wines.franciacorta.title: Franciacorta
wiki.art.wines.franciacorta.description: Franciacorta is Italian sparkling wine traditional method. Lombardy. Considered 'Italian Champagne'.
wiki.art.wines.franciacorta.tips: Ca' del Bosco, Bellavista premium. More structured than Prosecco.
wiki.art.wines.english-sparkling.title: English sparkling
wiki.art.wines.english-sparkling.descrip: English sparkling wine emerging since 2000s. Favorable climate change. Traditional method.
wiki.art.wines.english-sparkling.region: Sussex, Kent UK. Calcareous soils similar Champagne.
wiki.art.wines.english-sparkling.charact: Citrus, mineral, brioche, similar Champagne style.
wiki.art.wines.english-sparkling.tips: Nyetimber, Gusbourne, Hambledon premium. World's 50 Best Wine surprise.
wiki.art.wines.port-vintage.title: Vintage Port
wiki.art.wines.port-vintage.description: Vintage Port from excellent single year. 20-50 years bottle aging. Premium Port category.
wiki.art.wines.port-vintage.tips: Only declared years. Taylor's, Fonseca, Graham's top. Min 20 years bottle aging.
wiki.art.wines.port-tawny.title: Tawny Port
wiki.art.wines.port-tawny.description: Tawny Port aged in oxidative barrel. 10, 20, 30, 40 years. Nutty, complex.
wiki.art.wines.port-tawny.tips: 10 Year Tawny accessible, 30 Year Tawny premium. Barrel aging, not bottle.
wiki.art.wines.port-ruby.title: Ruby Port
wiki.art.wines.port-ruby.description: Young, fruity, non-aged Ruby Port. Entry-level Port category.
wiki.art.wines.port-ruby.tips: Ruby is entry-level. Reserve Ruby premium within category. For cocktails and dessert.
wiki.art.wines.port-white.title: White Port
wiki.art.wines.port-white.description: White Port made with white grapes. Aperitif or with tonic.
wiki.art.wines.port-white.tips: White Port + tonic + lime is Portuguese aperitif. Niepoort White Dry premium.
wiki.art.wines.sherry-fino.title: Fino Sherry
wiki.art.wines.sherry-fino.description: Dry Fino sherry under flor (yeast layer). Saline, mineral, bone-dry.
wiki.art.wines.sherry-fino.tips: Tio Pepe, La Gitana standard. Refrigerate after opening (oxidizes fast). Pairs with jamón.
wiki.art.wines.sherry-manzanilla.title: Manzanilla Sherry
wiki.art.wines.sherry-manzanilla.descrip: Manzanilla = Fino from Atlantic coast Sanlúcar de Barrameda. More saline than regular Fino.
wiki.art.wines.sherry-manzanilla.tips: La Gitana, Solear standard. Pairs perfectly with Atlantic seafood.
wiki.art.wines.sherry-amontillado.title: Amontillado Sherry
wiki.art.wines.sherry-amontillado.descri: Amontillado sherry — Fino that lost flor + aged oxidative. More complex than Fino.
wiki.art.wines.sherry-amontillado.tips: Lustau Amontillado Los Arcos premium. Pairs with soup, paté.
wiki.art.wines.sherry-oloroso.title: Oloroso Sherry
wiki.art.wines.sherry-oloroso.descriptio: Oloroso sherry aged oxidatively without flor. Rich, full-body, premium aging.
wiki.art.wines.sherry-oloroso.tips: Lustau, Bodegas Tradición premium. Pairs with lamb, aged cheese.
wiki.art.wines.sherry-pedro-ximenez.desc: PX sherry from sun-dried Pedro Ximénez grapes. Extreme sweet, dessert wine.
wiki.art.wines.sherry-pedro-ximenez.tips: Pour over vanilla ice cream — legendary combo. Bodegas Tradición VORS PX top.
wiki.art.wines.sherry-cream.title: Cream Sherry
wiki.art.wines.sherry-cream.description: Cream sherry is Oloroso + PX blend. Balanced sweet, popular UK historic.
wiki.art.wines.sherry-cream.tips: Harvey's Bristol Cream iconic. More accessible than pure PX.
wiki.art.wines.marsala.title: Marsala
wiki.art.wines.marsala.description: Marsala Sicilian fortified wine. Cooking standard, also dessert.
wiki.art.wines.marsala.tips: Cooking grade vs Vergine premium. Florio premium Sicilian.
wiki.art.wines.vin-santo.title: Vin Santo
wiki.art.wines.vin-santo.description: Tuscan Vin Santo from dried grapes. Sweet dessert, long aging.
wiki.art.wines.vin-santo.tips: Traditional pair with cantucci (dipped in wine). Avignonesi premium.
wiki.art.wines.tokaj-aszu.title: Tokaji Aszú
wiki.art.wines.tokaj-aszu.description: Hungarian Tokaji Aszú from botrytis (noble rot) grapes. Legendary sweet dessert.
wiki.art.wines.tokaj-aszu.tips: 5-6 Puttonyos premium. Royal Tokaji, Disznókő premium estate.
wiki.art.wines.ice-wine.title: Ice wine
wiki.art.wines.ice-wine.description: Ice wine (Eiswein) from vine-frozen grapes. Concentrated sweet dessert.
wiki.art.wines.ice-wine.characteristics: Citrus, honey, complex sweetness with acidity.
wiki.art.wines.ice-wine.tips: Inniskillin Vidal Ice Wine Canadian premium. German Riesling Eiswein.
wiki.art.wines.passito.title: Passito
wiki.art.wines.passito.description: Italian Passito wine from dried grapes. Concentrated sweet.
wiki.art.wines.passito.tips: Passito di Pantelleria DOCG premium. Recioto della Valpolicella red passito.
wiki.art.wines.rose-provence.title: Provence rosé
wiki.art.wines.rose-provence.description: Provence rosé elegant pale pink style. Mediterranean grape blend. World standard for premium rosé.
wiki.art.wines.rose-provence.tips: Whispering Angel, Miraval (Brad Pitt) mainstream. Domaines Ott premium.
wiki.art.wines.rose-tavel.title: Tavel rosé
wiki.art.wines.rose-tavel.description: Rhône Tavel rosé is darker and more structured than Provence. Only French rosé with own AOC.
wiki.art.wines.rose-tavel.tips: Tavel is 'rosé of kings' (Louis XIV preferred). More full-body than Provence.
wiki.art.wines.orange-wine.title: Orange wine
wiki.art.wines.orange-wine.description: Orange wine = white wine fermented with skins (skin contact). Yellow-orange color. Traditional Georgia (qvevri).
wiki.art.wines.orange-wine.region: Georgia (traditional). Friuli Italy. Slovenia. Modern global.
wiki.art.wines.orange-wine.tips: Radikon (Friuli), Pheasant's Tears (Georgia) iconic. Acquired taste.
wiki.art.wines.natural-wine.title: Natural wine
wiki.art.wines.natural-wine.description: Natural wine = no additives, no filtration, minimal sulfite. Post-2010s movement.
wiki.art.wines.natural-wine.tips: Marcel Lapierre Beaujolais (founder). Acquired taste. RAW Wine fair London/NY.
wiki.art.wines.biodynamic-wine.title: Biodynamic wine
wiki.art.wines.biodynamic-wine.descripti: Biodynamic wine based on Rudolf Steiner biodynamic agriculture (1924). Lunar calendar + preparations.
wiki.art.wines.biodynamic-wine.character: Variable by producer. Tendency mineral, terroir-expressive.
wiki.art.wines.biodynamic-wine.tips: Demeter certification standard. Domaine Leflaive (Burgundy), Eyrie Vineyards Oregon top.
wiki.art.cocktails.old-fashioned-history: The original cocktail — defined 1806 (Hudson newspaper): spirit + sugar + bitters + water.
1806 definition. Pre-Prohibition standard. 2000s revival via Don Draper Mad Men.
60ml bourbon/rye + sugar cube + 2-3 dashes Angostura + water. Stir over ice.
DOF glass + ice block. Orange peel garnish. Simplest yet most complex cocktail.
wiki.art.cocktails.manhattan-history.des: Manhattan created at Manhattan Club NYC 1874. Whiskey + vermouth + bitters. Spirit-forward temple.
wiki.art.cocktails.manhattan-history.his: Manhattan Club NYC 1874. Banquet for Lady Randolph Churchill. King of pre-Prohibition cocktails.
wiki.art.cocktails.manhattan-history.rec: 60ml rye + 30ml sweet vermouth + 2 dashes Angostura. Stirred. Cherry.
wiki.art.cocktails.manhattan-history.tip: Traditional rye base. Luxardo cherry, no glace. Coupe up.
wiki.art.cocktails.martini-evolution.des: Martini evolved from Martinez (1860s) to modern Dry Martini. Sweet → wetter → bone-dry → wet revival.
wiki.art.cocktails.martini-evolution.his: 1860s Martinez. Pre-Prohibition with orange bitters. Mid-century bone-dry Bond era. Modern wetter revival.
wiki.art.cocktails.martini-evolution.rec: 75ml gin + 15ml dry vermouth + orange bitters dash. Stir. Lemon twist.
wiki.art.cocktails.martini-evolution.tip: Stir 30-45s. Olive vs lemon twist preference. Wet (3:1) vs Dry (5:1) ratio.
wiki.art.cocktails.dry-martini-method.de: Orthodox Dry Martini method: stirred gin + dry vermouth, not shaken (despite Bond).
wiki.art.cocktails.dry-martini-method.hi: Bond 'shaken not stirred' is heretical — stir is correct.
wiki.art.cocktails.dry-martini-method.re: 75ml gin + 10ml Noilly Prat. Stir 30s ice cold. Lemon twist.
wiki.art.cocktails.dry-martini-method.ti: Pre-frozen glass. Key vermouth quality (Noilly Prat, Dolin). Optional olive.
wiki.art.cocktails.vesper-james-bond-ori: Vesper Martini invented by Ian Fleming in Casino Royale (1953). Gin + vodka + Kina Lillet.
Casino Royale 1953. Bond's first order. Kina Lillet (with quinine) replaced by Lillet Blanc 1986.
75ml Gordon's gin + 25ml vodka + 7.5ml Kina Lillet (or Cocchi Americano). Shaken (Bond style). Lemon twist.
Cocchi Americano is correct historic Kina Lillet replacement.
wiki.art.cocktails.daiquiri-original-cub: Daiquiri invented in Cuba 1898 by Jennings Cox. Cuban rum + lime + sugar.
Daiquirí Mine, Cuba. Cox created recipe with local rum + lime + sugar. Arrived at NYC Navy Club.
60ml white rum + 25ml fresh lime juice + 15ml simple syrup. Cold shake. Coupe.
Always fresh lime. Hard shake 12-15s. Embury 8:3:2 ratio (Sour template).
wiki.art.cocktails.daiquiri-hemingway.de: Hemingway Daiquiri created by Constante Ribalaigua at El Floridita Havana for diabetic Papa Hemingway.
wiki.art.cocktails.daiquiri-hemingway.hi: Floridita 1930s. Hemingway asked 'no sugar, double rum'. Constante created with grapefruit + maraschino.
wiki.art.cocktails.daiquiri-hemingway.re: 75ml white rum + 15ml lime + 15ml grapefruit + 7.5ml maraschino. Shaken or blended.
wiki.art.cocktails.daiquiri-hemingway.ti: Blended traditional version. Coupe up. No simple syrup.
wiki.art.cocktails.mojito-cuban-roots.de: Mojito 16th-century Cuba origin as 'El Draque' (Sir Francis Drake). Rum + mint + lime + sugar + soda.
wiki.art.cocktails.mojito-cuban-roots.hi: 16th-century El Draque. Modernized 19th-20th centuries. La Bodeguita del Medio Havana standard. Hemingway client.
wiki.art.cocktails.mojito-cuban-roots.re: 50ml white rum + 25ml lime + 8 mint leaves + 2tsp sugar + soda. Build/muddle.
wiki.art.cocktails.mojito-cuban-roots.ti: Soft mint slap (not hard muddle). Soda at end. Crushed ice.
wiki.art.cocktails.sazerac-new-orleans.d: Sazerac invented in New Orleans 1830 by Antoine Peychaud. Cognac → rye after phylloxera.
wiki.art.cocktails.sazerac-new-orleans.h: Peychaud's Pharmacy NOLA. Originally cognac + Peychaud's. Changed to rye 19th century due to European phylloxera.
wiki.art.cocktails.sazerac-new-orleans.r: 60ml rye + sugar cube + 3 dashes Peychaud's + absinthe rinse. Stir over ice. Lemon peel.
wiki.art.cocktails.sazerac-new-orleans.t: Absinthe rinse signature. Lemon peel not dropped (NOLA tradition). Frozen glass.
wiki.art.cocktails.mint-julep-kentucky.d: Mint Julep official Kentucky Derby cocktail since 1938. Bourbon + mint + sugar + crushed ice.
wiki.art.cocktails.mint-julep-kentucky.h: Southern US 19th century origin. Adopted Kentucky Derby 1938. 120,000+ served each Derby.
wiki.art.cocktails.mint-julep-kentucky.r: 60ml bourbon + 10ml simple + 8 mint leaves + crushed ice. Build in julep cup.
wiki.art.cocktails.mint-julep-kentucky.t: Copper/silver julep cup. Soft mint slap. Crushed ice piled high.
Whiskey Sour is Sour family template. 1862 Jerry Thomas book.
Jerry Thomas 1862 How to Mix Drinks. British sailors brought sour concept.
60ml bourbon + 22ml lemon + 15ml simple. Optional egg white. Shaken. Coupe.
Egg white modern version. Embury 8:3:2 ratio.
wiki.art.cocktails.whiskey-sour-egg-whit: Modern Whiskey Sour with egg white — stable foam + silky texture.
Egg white version post-Prohibition. Re-popularized in modern revival.
60ml bourbon + 22ml lemon + 15ml simple + 1 egg white. Dry shake 30s + wet shake 15s.
Dry shake first is key. Reverse dry shake variant also works.
wiki.art.cocktails.amaretto-sour-foam.de: Amaretto Sour reinvented by Jeffrey Morgenthaler with overproof bourbon + egg white.
wiki.art.cocktails.amaretto-sour-foam.hi: Traditional Amaretto + lemon cloying sweet. Morgenthaler 2010 added bourbon + egg white.
wiki.art.cocktails.amaretto-sour-foam.re: 45ml Amaretto + 22ml cask-strength bourbon + 22ml lemon + 15ml simple + egg white. Dry shake.
wiki.art.cocktails.amaretto-sour-foam.ti: Overproof bourbon key for balance. Cherry garnish.
wiki.art.cocktails.ny-sour-red-wine-floa: New York Sour = Whiskey Sour with red wine float on top. Distinctive visual + flavor.
Late 1800s Chicago variant. Re-popularized in 2000s cocktail revival.
60ml bourbon + 22ml lemon + 15ml simple. Shake. Strain. Float 15ml red wine slowly.
Wine over back of spoon for perfect float. Malbec or Cabernet ideal.
wiki.art.cocktails.pisco-sour-peruvian-m: Pisco Sour Peruvian national cocktail (Chile also claims). Pisco + lime + sugar + egg white + bitters.
Victor Vaughen Morris in Lima 1920s, American bartender. Original Morris's Bar.
75ml pisco + 25ml lime + 22ml simple + egg white + 3 dashes Angostura on top. Dry shake.
Angostura drops floral pattern signature. Always fresh lime.
wiki.art.cocktails.gimlet-naval-roots.de: Gimlet invented by Royal Navy 1867. Anti-scurvy: gin + lime cordial. Dr. Lauchlin Rose.
wiki.art.cocktails.gimlet-naval-roots.hi: Rose's Lime Cordial patented 1867 by Dr. Rose. British Navy required lime to prevent scurvy.
wiki.art.cocktails.gimlet-naval-roots.re: 60ml gin + 30ml Rose's Lime Cordial (or homemade). Stirred over ice. Lime wheel.
wiki.art.cocktails.gimlet-naval-roots.ti: Homemade cordial version superior. Rose's industrial flat. Stir, not shake.
wiki.art.cocktails.tom-collins-history.d: Tom Collins classic cocktail — gin Sour + soda. Originally Old Tom gin (sweeter).
wiki.art.cocktails.tom-collins-history.h: Disputed 1870s NYC origin. 'Tom Collins hoax' popular pre-cocktail joke.
wiki.art.cocktails.tom-collins-history.r: 50ml Old Tom gin + 25ml lemon + 15ml simple + soda. Build collins glass.
wiki.art.cocktails.tom-collins-history.t: Authentic Old Tom gin (Hayman's, Ransom). London Dry works but different.
wiki.art.cocktails.john-collins-vs-tom.d: John Collins = Tom Collins but with whiskey instead of gin. Common confusion.
wiki.art.cocktails.john-collins-vs-tom.h: Original John Collins with Holland gin. Adapted to whiskey post-Prohibition.
wiki.art.cocktails.john-collins-vs-tom.t: Classic pre-Prohibition John Collins with Holland gin. Modern whiskey common.
wiki.art.cocktails.ramos-gin-fizz-method: Ramos Gin Fizz created by Henry Ramos NOLA 1888. Legendary 12+ min shake.
Imperial Cabinet Saloon NOLA. Ramos employed 'shaker boys' to prepare masses.
60ml gin + 22ml lemon + 22ml lime + 22ml cream + 15ml simple + 3 dashes orange flower water + egg white + soda finish.
Dry shake 1-2 min minimum. Soda at end SLOW pour. Towering foam signature.
wiki.art.cocktails.gin-fizz-silver-vs-go: Silver Fizz with egg white, Golden Fizz with yolk, Royal Fizz with whole egg. Different textures.
Silver = egg white. Golden = yolk. Royal = both. Base gin + lemon + simple + soda.
Silver most common today. Golden rich, dessert-like.
wiki.art.cocktails.negroni-100-years.des: Negroni invented 1919 Florence by Count Camillo Negroni. 100-year anniversary 2019.
wiki.art.cocktails.negroni-100-years.his: Caffè Casoni Florence 1919. Count asked for stronger Americano. Bartender Fosco Scarselli swapped soda for gin.
wiki.art.cocktails.negroni-100-years.rec: 30ml gin + 30ml Campari + 30ml sweet vermouth. Stir. Orange peel. DOF rocks.
wiki.art.cocktails.negroni-100-years.tip: 1:1:1 sacred ratio. Barrel aging works. Flame orange peel premium service.
wiki.art.cocktails.negroni-sbagliato-mis: Negroni Sbagliato ('Wrong Negroni') — Negroni with prosecco instead of gin. Milan 1972.
Mirko Stocchetto Bar Basso Milan 1972. Served prosecco accidentally. 2022 House of the Dragon popularity boom.
30ml Campari + 30ml sweet vermouth + 30ml prosecco. Build over ice. Orange.
Lower ABV than regular Negroni. Perfect aperitif.
wiki.art.cocktails.americano-aperitivo.d: Americano = Negroni without gin (Campari + vermouth + soda). Classic Italian aperitif.
wiki.art.cocktails.americano-aperitivo.h: 1860s Milano-Torino (Campari + Vermouth) + soda added in 1900s = Americano. Negroni's predecessor.
wiki.art.cocktails.americano-aperitivo.r: 30ml Campari + 30ml sweet vermouth + soda. Build collins glass. Orange.
wiki.art.cocktails.americano-aperitivo.t: Lower ABV. Refreshing summer aperitif. Bond orders Americano in Casino Royale (pre-Vesper).
Aperol Spritz #1 selling summer cocktail globally 2010s-2020s.
Aperol created 1919 Padua. Veneto spritz tradition. 2010s global boom via Campari Group marketing.
60ml Aperol + 90ml prosecco + soda splash. Build big wine glass with ice. Orange.
3-2-1 ratio (prosecco-Aperol-soda). Huge glass. Signature Italian aperitif.
wiki.art.cocktails.garibaldi-tall-versio: Garibaldi = Campari + freshly fluffy-squeezed orange juice. Dante NYC perfected technique.
Classic simple Italian origin. Naren Young Dante NYC 2015 reinvented with fluffy juice technique.
45ml Campari + 120ml freshly squeezed orange juice. Tall glass + ice.
Always fresh juice. Fluffy texture (oxygenated by electric juicer Dante) signature.
wiki.art.cocktails.milano-torino.title: Milano-Torino
wiki.art.cocktails.milano-torino.descrip: Milano-Torino (Mi-To) = Campari (Milan) + sweet vermouth (Turin). Americano and Negroni predecessor.
wiki.art.cocktails.milano-torino.history: 1860s northern Italy origin. Campari (Milan industry) + Carpano (Turin tradition) combination.
wiki.art.cocktails.milano-torino.recipe: 30ml Campari + 30ml sweet vermouth. Stir over ice. Orange peel.
wiki.art.cocktails.milano-torino.tips: No soda (Americano) or gin (Negroni). Undiluted base.
wiki.art.cocktails.bellini.title: Bellini
wiki.art.cocktails.bellini.description: Bellini invented by Giuseppe Cipriani Harry's Bar Venice 1948. Prosecco + white peach purée.
wiki.art.cocktails.bellini.history: Cipriani 1948 named after painter Giovanni Bellini. Only in white peach season (summer).
wiki.art.cocktails.bellini.recipe: 30ml white peach purée + 90ml cold prosecco. Build flute. DO NOT stir.
wiki.art.cocktails.bellini.tips: Fresh white peach (no canned). Summer only. Frozen champagne flute.
wiki.art.cocktails.bramble-modern-classi: Bramble invented by Dick Bradsell London 1984. Modern British classic.
Fred's Club Soho 1984. Bradsell wanted British cocktail with native berries.
60ml gin + 25ml lemon + 15ml simple. Shake. Strain crushed ice. 15ml Crème de Mûre drizzle.
Signature crushed ice. Crème de Mûre 'bleed' visual drizzle. Lemon wedge + berry.
wiki.art.cocktails.breakfast-martini.des: Breakfast Martini invented by Salvatore Calabrese Library Bar Lanesborough London 1990s. Gin + marmalade.
wiki.art.cocktails.breakfast-martini.his: Salvatore Calabrese 1990s. Inspired by British breakfast marmalade.
wiki.art.cocktails.breakfast-martini.rec: 50ml gin + 15ml triple sec + 15ml lemon + 1tsp orange marmalade. Shake.
wiki.art.cocktails.breakfast-martini.tip: Frank Cooper's Oxford original marmalade. Balanced sweet-bitter.
wiki.art.cocktails.espresso-martini-revi: Espresso Martini 2020s boom after 2000s dormancy. TikTok + Gen Z drove revival.
Invented Bradsell 1983 NYC. 1990s boom. 2000s dormancy. 2020 post-COVID revival.
45ml vodka + 30ml Kahlúa + 30ml espresso shot. Hard shake. Coupe. 3 coffee beans.
Fresh espresso shot. Very hard shake for foam. Coupe up with beans.
wiki.art.cocktails.espresso-martini-meth: Espresso Martini method for perfect foam: hard shake with fresh espresso + abundant ice.
Bradsell technique standard. Foam comes from espresso crema + agitation.
45ml vodka + 30ml Kahlúa + 30ml HOT espresso + ice. Hard shake 15s.
Espresso must be HOT (not cold). Very hard shake. 3 beans tradition (health-happiness-prosperity).
Aviation invented Hugo Ensslin 1916 NYC. Nearly forgotten until 2007 revival with Crème de Violette relaunch.
Ensslin 1916. Hotel Wallick NYC bartender. Crème de Violette discontinued 1960s = lost recipe.
45ml gin + 15ml lemon + 7.5ml maraschino + 7.5ml Crème de Violette. Shake. Coupe.
Pale blue/purple color signature. Luxardo cherry garnish.
wiki.art.cocktails.white-lady-london.des: White Lady created Harry MacElhone Ciro's London 1919, perfected Harry's Bar Paris.
wiki.art.cocktails.white-lady-london.his: MacElhone 1919. Refined 1929 Paris. Craddock Savoy version 1930 standard.
wiki.art.cocktails.white-lady-london.rec: 50ml gin + 22ml Cointreau + 22ml lemon + 1 egg white. Hard shake. Coupe.
wiki.art.cocktails.white-lady-london.tip: Modern egg white version. Clean balanced citrus.
wiki.art.cocktails.corpse-reviver-no2.de: Corpse Reviver #2 classic hangover cure by Harry Craddock Savoy. Gin + Cointreau + Lillet + lemon + absinthe.
wiki.art.cocktails.corpse-reviver-no2.hi: Craddock Savoy 1930. To revive morning hangover.
wiki.art.cocktails.corpse-reviver-no2.re: 22ml gin + 22ml Cointreau + 22ml Lillet Blanc + 22ml lemon + dash absinthe. Shake. Coupe.
wiki.art.cocktails.corpse-reviver-no2.ti: Craddock warning 'four in quick succession will un-revive the corpse'. Equal parts 4 ingredients.
wiki.art.cocktails.last-word-detroit.des: Last Word forgotten for decades until Murray Stenson Zig Zag Cafe Seattle 2004 revival.
wiki.art.cocktails.last-word-detroit.his: Detroit Athletic Club Prohibition era origin. Recipe in Ted Saucier's Bottoms Up (1951).
wiki.art.cocktails.last-word-detroit.rec: 22ml gin + 22ml Green Chartreuse + 22ml maraschino + 22ml lime. Equal parts. Shake. Coupe.
wiki.art.cocktails.last-word-detroit.tip: Stenson 2004 rediscovery = cocktail revival temple. Equal parts perfectly balanced.
wiki.art.cocktails.bijou-italian-jewel.d: Bijou cocktail named for gemstone trinity — gin (diamond) + Green Chartreuse (emerald) + vermouth (ruby).
wiki.art.cocktails.bijou-italian-jewel.h: Harry Johnson Bartender's Manual 1900. Equal parts triplet.
wiki.art.cocktails.bijou-italian-jewel.r: 22ml gin + 22ml Green Chartreuse + 22ml sweet vermouth + dash orange bitters. Stir. Coupe.
wiki.art.cocktails.bijou-italian-jewel.t: Cherry garnish. Three equal gemstones visual story.
wiki.art.cocktails.rusty-nail-scottish.d: Rusty Nail = Scotch whisky + Drambuie. Classic mid-century British cocktail.
wiki.art.cocktails.rusty-nail-scottish.h: 1937 NYC World's Fair Scottish exhibit. Popularized 1960s rat pack era.
wiki.art.cocktails.rusty-nail-scottish.r: 45ml Scotch + 25ml Drambuie. Build over rocks. Lemon twist.
wiki.art.cocktails.rusty-nail-scottish.t: Blend or aged Scotch. Drambuie softens Scotch. Frank Sinatra preferred.
wiki.art.cocktails.french-75-history.des: French 75 named after French 75mm artillery gun. Cognac (original) or gin (modern) + champagne.
wiki.art.cocktails.french-75-history.his: Harry MacElhone Paris 1915 (during WW1) supposedly invented. Standard Savoy Craddock 1930.
wiki.art.cocktails.french-75-history.rec: 30ml gin + 15ml lemon + 7.5ml simple + champagne top. Shake first 3. Flute.
wiki.art.cocktails.french-75-history.tip: Original cognac, today gin standard. Cold champagne absolute.
Sidecar invented Paris 1920s post-WW1. Cognac + Cointreau + lemon. Daisy family template.
Disputed: MacElhone Harry's Bar Paris vs Ritz Hotel Paris. Both 1920s.
50ml cognac + 22ml Cointreau + 22ml lemon. Shake. Coupe (sugar rim optional).
Embury 8:3:2 ratio works. Sugar rim modern optional.
wiki.art.cocktails.between-the-sheets.de: Between the Sheets Sidecar variant with rum added. Cognac + rum + Cointreau + lemon. Suggestive name.
wiki.art.cocktails.between-the-sheets.hi: Also Harry's Bar Paris 1920s. Naughty 1920s cocktail named.
wiki.art.cocktails.between-the-sheets.re: 22ml cognac + 22ml white rum + 22ml Cointreau + 22ml lemon. Shake. Coupe.
wiki.art.cocktails.between-the-sheets.ti: Equal parts. Sweeter than regular Sidecar due to rum.
wiki.art.cocktails.vieux-carre-new-orlea: Vieux Carré invented by Walter Bergeron Hotel Monteleone NOLA 1937. Rye + cognac + vermouth + Bénédictine + bitters.
Hotel Monteleone Carousel Bar 1937. Bergeron created NOLA signature cocktail.
22ml rye + 22ml cognac + 22ml sweet vermouth + 1 tsp Bénédictine + 2 dashes Peychaud's + 2 dashes Angostura. Stir.
Multi-spirit complex. Hotel Monteleone Carousel Bar visitable.
wiki.art.cocktails.final-ward-modern.des: Final Ward = Phil Ward Death & Co NYC variant of Last Word with rye + lemon. Modern classic.
wiki.art.cocktails.final-ward-modern.his: Phil Ward Death & Co 2006-2010. Last Word rediscovery variant.
wiki.art.cocktails.final-ward-modern.rec: 22ml rye + 22ml Green Chartreuse + 22ml maraschino + 22ml lemon. Shake. Coupe.
wiki.art.cocktails.final-ward-modern.tip: Lemon instead of lime. Rye instead of gin. Last Word sour version.
wiki.art.cocktails.mary-pickford-cocktai: Mary Pickford cocktail created in Cuba 1920s for silent film star Mary Pickford visit.
Hotel Nacional or Sevilla-Biltmore Havana 1920s. Pickford Prohibition-era Cuba visit.
60ml white rum + 60ml pineapple juice + 7.5ml grenadine + 7.5ml maraschino. Shake. Coupe.
Classic version with real grenadine. Tropical but refined.
wiki.art.cocktails.bee-s-knees-prohibiti: Bee's Knees invented Prohibition era to mask bad gin with honey + lemon. Frank Meier Ritz Paris attributed.
1920s Prohibition. Honey masks rough bathtub gin. Frank Meier Ritz Paris 1930s documentation.
60ml gin + 22ml lemon + 22ml honey syrup. Shake. Coupe. Lemon twist.
Honey syrup (honey + hot water 1:1). Prohibition cocktail mask era. Simple refreshing.
wiki.art.cocktails.southside-history.des: Southside cocktail associated with Chicago South Side mafia (Capone). Gin + mint + lime + sugar. Mojito without rum.
wiki.art.cocktails.southside-history.his: Disputed: Chicago Capone South Side mafia preferred or NYC 21 Club. Mid-Prohibition.
wiki.art.cocktails.southside-history.rec: 60ml gin + 22ml lime + 22ml simple + 6 mint leaves. Shake. Coupe. Mint garnish.
wiki.art.cocktails.southside-history.tip: Basically Gin Mojito. No soda. Fresh lime juice.
wiki.art.cocktails.ward-eight-boston.des: Ward Eight cocktail created Locke-Ober Restaurant Boston 1898 for Ward 8 political election victory.
wiki.art.cocktails.ward-eight-boston.his: Locke-Ober Boston 1898. Martin Lomasney's Ward 8 election win celebration.
wiki.art.cocktails.ward-eight-boston.rec: 60ml bourbon + 15ml lemon + 15ml orange + 10ml real grenadine. Shake. Coupe.
wiki.art.cocktails.ward-eight-boston.tip: Real grenadine key — no Rose's. Classic pre-Prohibition cocktail.
wiki.art.cocktails.boulevardier-paris.de: Boulevardier = Negroni with bourbon instead of gin. Harry MacElhone Paris 1927.
wiki.art.cocktails.boulevardier-paris.hi: Harry's Bar Paris 1927. Erskine Gwynne 'Boulevardier' magazine founder.
wiki.art.cocktails.boulevardier-paris.re: 45ml bourbon + 30ml Campari + 30ml sweet vermouth. Stir. Coupe up or DOF.
wiki.art.cocktails.boulevardier-paris.ti: Higher bourbon ratio than 1:1:1 Negroni. Rye also works as variant.
wiki.art.cocktails.blood-and-sand-spanis: Blood and Sand cocktail named after 1922 Rudolph Valentino bullfighter film. Scotch + cherry + orange.
Inspired by 1922 Blood and Sand film. Standard Craddock Savoy 1930.
22ml Scotch + 22ml Cherry Heering + 22ml sweet vermouth + 22ml orange juice. Shake. Coupe.
Equal parts. Sweet Scotch cocktail. Original Cherry Heering.
wiki.art.cocktails.scofflaw-cocktail.des: Anti-Prohibition Scofflaw cocktail. Name coined 1924 Boston Herald contest for 'lawless drinker'.
wiki.art.cocktails.scofflaw-cocktail.his: Harry's Bar Paris 1924 — Jock McElhone (Harry's son) created after Boston contest.
wiki.art.cocktails.scofflaw-cocktail.rec: 45ml rye + 30ml dry vermouth + 22ml lemon + 22ml grenadine + dash orange bitters. Shake.
wiki.art.cocktails.scofflaw-cocktail.tip: Word 'scofflaw' coined for cocktail. Pre-Prohibition gem.
wiki.art.cocktails.hanky-panky-london.de: Hanky Panky invented by Ada Coleman American Bar Savoy London 1903 for actor Sir Charles Hawtrey.
wiki.art.cocktails.hanky-panky-london.hi: Ada Coleman Savoy 1903. Hawtrey 'something with a bit of punch'. Coleman created with Fernet.
wiki.art.cocktails.hanky-panky-london.re: 45ml gin + 45ml sweet vermouth + 2 dashes Fernet-Branca. Stir. Coupe up. Orange.
wiki.art.cocktails.hanky-panky-london.ti: Fernet trace key — without it Sweet Martini. Bartender's drink par excellence.
wiki.art.cocktails.mai-tai-original-1944: Mai Tai original Trader Vic 1944 Oakland. Specific recipe — rum + curaçao + orgeat + lime.
Trader Vic's Oakland 1944. Tahitian friend tasted: 'Maita'i roa ae!' (Tahitian 'out of this world').
30ml Jamaican rum + 30ml agricole rum + 22ml dry curaçao + 15ml orgeat + 22ml lime. Shake. Crushed ice.
No pineapple juice (modern pop version). Rum split key. Cherry + mint garnish.
wiki.art.cocktails.mai-tai-evolution.des: Mai Tai degraded from Trader Vic original to Hawaii 'tourist mai tai' with OJ + grenadine + pineapple.
wiki.art.cocktails.mai-tai-evolution.his: 1944 Trader Vic original → 1959 Royal Hawaiian Hotel tropical floor show variant → modern tourist.
wiki.art.cocktails.mai-tai-evolution.rec: Original Vic recipe vs tourist (rum + OJ + pineapple + grenadine + crushed ice).
wiki.art.cocktails.mai-tai-evolution.tip: Beachbum Berry, Martin Cate, Trader Vic descendants rescuing original. Tourist version mainstream.
wiki.art.cocktails.zombie-don-the-beachc: Zombie invented Don the Beachcomber Hollywood 1934. Multi-rum lethal — '1 per customer' rule.
Donn Beach 1934. Recipe secret until Beachbum Berry decoded in 2007.
45ml gold rum + 45ml dark rum + 30ml 151 overproof rum + Falernum + lime + grapefruit + Pernod + grenadine + Angostura.
Iconic 'no more than 2' rule. Tiki mug + mint. Serve crushed ice.
wiki.art.cocktails.pina-colada-puerto-ri: Piña Colada national Puerto Rico cocktail since 1978. Ramón 'Monchito' Marrero Caribe Hilton 1954.
Monchito Caribe Hilton San Juan 1954. National drink Puerto Rico 1978.
60ml white rum + 90ml pineapple juice + 30ml coconut cream. Blend with ice. Pineapple wedge.
Coco Lopez coconut cream original. Fresh pineapple juice key. Cherry garnish.
wiki.art.cocktails.pain-killer-bvi.title: Painkiller
wiki.art.cocktails.pain-killer-bvi.descr: Painkiller created Soggy Dollar Bar Jost Van Dyke BVI 1971. Pusser's rum signature.
