wiki.art.cocktails.pain-killer-bvi.histo: Daphne Henderson Soggy Dollar BVI 1971. Pusser's rum official 1989.
wiki.art.cocktails.pain-killer-bvi.recip: 60ml Pusser's rum + 120ml pineapple juice + 60ml orange juice + 30ml coconut cream. Blend or shake.
wiki.art.cocktails.pain-killer-bvi.tips: Fresh grated nutmeg on top signature. Authentic Pusser's rum key.
Jungle Bird invented Hilton Kuala Lumpur 1978 for hotel welcome drinks. Campari + rum.
Hilton KL 1978. Unique Tiki cocktail with Campari — sweetness + bitter balance.
45ml Jamaican rum + 22ml Campari + 45ml pineapple juice + 15ml lime + 15ml simple. Shake. Tiki mug crushed.
Modern Tiki classic post-revival. Jeffrey Morgenthaler perfected recipe.
wiki.art.cocktails.planter-s-punch-jamai: Planter's Punch Jamaican national cocktail. Rum + lime + sugar + soda + bitters. Traditional plantation drink.
19th-century Jamaican plantation origin. Myers's Rum brand secured recipe popularity 1900s.
60ml Jamaican dark rum + 22ml lime + 22ml simple + soda + 3 dashes Angostura. Build. Mint + cherry.
1-2-3-4 ratio (1 sour, 2 sweet, 3 strong, 4 weak). Traditional Myers's rum.
wiki.art.cocktails.hurricane-new-orleans: Hurricane created Pat O'Brien's NOLA 1940s during WW2 rum surplus. Iconic hurricane lamp glass.
Pat O'Brien's NOLA 1940s. WW2 rum overflow + whiskey shortage = rum punch creativity.
60ml light rum + 60ml dark rum + 30ml passion fruit + 30ml lime + 15ml grenadine + 15ml orange. Shake. Hurricane glass.
Mardi Gras signature. Hurricane lamp glass + iconic visual.
Queen's Park Swizzle created Queen's Park Hotel Port of Spain Trinidad 1920s. Rum swizzle + mint.
Queen's Park Hotel Trinidad 1920s. Trinidadian swizzle stick tradition.
60ml demerara rum + 22ml lime + 22ml simple + 8 mint leaves + 4 dashes Angostura. Swizzle crushed ice.
Trinidadian swizzle stick authenticity. Angostura visual on top.
wiki.art.cocktails.test-pilot-tiki.title: Test Pilot
wiki.art.cocktails.test-pilot-tiki.descr: Test Pilot created Don the Beachcomber for WW2 test pilots. Complex triple rum.
wiki.art.cocktails.test-pilot-tiki.histo: Donn Beach 1940s. For approved aviators pre-flight (ironically).
wiki.art.cocktails.test-pilot-tiki.recip: 45ml dark rum + 22ml white rum + 15ml lime + 15ml dry curaçao + 7.5ml falernum + 3 dashes Angostura + dash Pernod. Shake. Pebble ice.
wiki.art.cocktails.test-pilot-tiki.tips: Beachbum Berry decoded. Original Tiki canon.
wiki.art.cocktails.el-presidente-cuba.de: El Presidente Cuban national cocktail pre-Prohibition era. Rum + white vermouth + curaçao + grenadine.
wiki.art.cocktails.el-presidente-cuba.hi: 1920s Havana, named after Cuban president Gerardo Machado. Pre-Prohibition US visitors drink.
wiki.art.cocktails.el-presidente-cuba.re: 60ml white rum + 30ml white vermouth + 15ml dry curaçao + dash grenadine. Stir. Coupe.
wiki.art.cocktails.el-presidente-cuba.ti: Refined, stirred. Pre-mojito gentleman version ground zero.
wiki.art.cocktails.cuba-libre-history.de: Cuba Libre created Havana 1900 post Spanish-American War. 'Por Cuba Libre' (free Cuba) toast.
wiki.art.cocktails.cuba-libre-history.hi: Havana 1900. US soldiers brought Coca-Cola, mixed with Cuban rum + lime = 'toast to Cuba Libre'.
wiki.art.cocktails.cuba-libre-history.re: 60ml Cuban rum + 15ml lime + Coca-Cola top. Build collins glass.
wiki.art.cocktails.cuba-libre-history.ti: Freshly squeezed lime. Coca-Cola original sweetness. Authentic Cuban Bacardí (pre-1960).
wiki.art.cocktails.michelada-mexico.desc: Michelada Mexican beer + lime + sauces + Worcestershire + Clamato (version) cocktail. Hangover cure.
wiki.art.cocktails.michelada-mexico.hist: 1960s San Luis Potosí or Veracruz Mexico origin. Beer-based national cocktail.
wiki.art.cocktails.michelada-mexico.reci: Mexican lager beer + 30ml lime + Worcestershire + Tabasco + salt rim. Build chela glass.
wiki.art.cocktails.michelada-mexico.tips: Clamato classic version (with tomato juice). Hot sauce to taste. Salt rim signature.
wiki.art.cocktails.paloma-mexico.title: Paloma
wiki.art.cocktails.paloma-mexico.descrip: Paloma Mexico's most popular cocktail after Margarita. Tequila + grapefruit soda + lime. Refreshing.
wiki.art.cocktails.paloma-mexico.history: Mexico 1950s-60s. Don Javier Delgado Corona supposedly La Capilla Tequila town.
wiki.art.cocktails.paloma-mexico.recipe: 60ml blanco tequila + 15ml lime + pinch salt + grapefruit soda (Squirt or Ting) top. Build tall.
wiki.art.cocktails.paloma-mexico.tips: Mexican Squirt or Ting (Jamaican) standard. Optional salt rim.
wiki.art.cocktails.caipirinha-brazil.des: Caipirinha Brazil's national cocktail. Cachaça + lime + sugar muddled. Served on the rocks.
wiki.art.cocktails.caipirinha-brazil.his: 19th-century Brazil as anti-Spanish flu medicine. Peasant cachaça + lime + sugar.
wiki.art.cocktails.caipirinha-brazil.rec: 60ml cachaça + 1 whole lime cut in wedges + 2 tsp sugar. Muddle lime + sugar. Add cachaça + ice. Stir.
wiki.art.cocktails.caipirinha-brazil.tip: Muddle lime (skin oil key). Best cachaça 51, Leblon, Yaguara. NOT Mojito (no mint, no soda).
wiki.art.cocktails.batida-brazil.title: Batida
wiki.art.cocktails.batida-brazil.descrip: Brazilian Batida blended cachaça + fruit + condensed milk cocktail. Tropical, dessert-style.
wiki.art.cocktails.batida-brazil.history: Brazil 20th century. Tropical fruit + cachaça invention.
wiki.art.cocktails.batida-brazil.recipe: 60ml cachaça + 90ml fruit purée (passion fruit, coconut, peach) + 30ml condensed milk + ice. Blend.
wiki.art.cocktails.batida-brazil.tips: Endless variants by fruit. Coconut batida (Batida de Coco) most popular.
wiki.art.cocktails.pisco-punch-san-franc: Pisco Punch created Duncan Nicol Bank Exchange SF 1900. Pisco + pineapple + lemon. Secret recipe.
Bank Exchange Saloon SF 1853. Duncan Nicol perfected 1880s-1900s. Recipe lost on his death 1926.
60ml Peruvian pisco + 30ml pineapple infused syrup + 22ml lemon + 22ml simple. Shake. Tall cup.
Approximate recipe (Wondrich rescued). Pineapple infusion key.
wiki.art.cocktails.chilcano-peru.title: Chilcano
wiki.art.cocktails.chilcano-peru.descrip: Peruvian Chilcano simple cocktail — pisco + ginger ale + lime + bitters. Refreshing.
wiki.art.cocktails.chilcano-peru.history: Lima Peru 1900s. Sailors brought ginger ale, Peruvian bartenders mixed with local pisco.
wiki.art.cocktails.chilcano-peru.recipe: 60ml pisco + 22ml lime + ginger ale top + 2 dashes Angostura. Build collins glass.
wiki.art.cocktails.chilcano-peru.tips: Real ginger beer better than ginger ale. Quebranta or acholado pisco standard.
wiki.art.cocktails.moscow-mule-copper-mu: Moscow Mule created 1941 LA with Smirnoff vodka + ginger beer + lime. Genius copper mug marketing.
John Martin + Jack Morgan + Sophie Berezinski 1941 LA. Smirnoff vodka + Cock'n'Bull ginger beer + Berezinski's copper mugs.
60ml vodka + 15ml lime + ginger beer top. Build copper mug. Mint + lime wheel.
Copper mug keeps cold + signature visual. Required real ginger beer.
wiki.art.cocktails.dark-and-stormy-bermu: Dark and Stormy Bermuda's national cocktail. Goslings Black Seal rum + ginger beer + lime. Goslings trademark.
Bermuda 1880s. Sailors mixed local Goslings dark rum + ginger beer. Goslings trademark.
60ml Goslings Black Seal rum + ginger beer top + 15ml lime. Build collins.
Goslings rum legal trademark (without Goslings = 'Dark 'N Stormy' technically incorrect).
wiki.art.cocktails.bloody-mary-history.d: Bloody Mary invented Fernand Petiot Harry's Bar Paris 1921. World brunch standard.
wiki.art.cocktails.bloody-mary-history.h: Petiot 1921 Paris. Arrived at St. Regis NYC 1934 with 'Red Snapper' name (Vanderbilt vetoed 'Bloody Mary').
wiki.art.cocktails.bloody-mary-history.r: 45ml vodka + 90ml tomato juice + Worcestershire + Tabasco + lime + salt + pepper. Roll/build. Celery.
wiki.art.cocktails.bloody-mary-history.t: Roll (no shake) keeps tomato structure. Creative garnish (celery, bacon, shrimp).
wiki.art.cocktails.bloody-mary-vs-bloody: Bloody Caesar = Canadian Bloody Mary with Clamato (tomato + clam juice). Walter Chell Calgary 1969.
Walter Chell Calgary 1969. Bloody Caesar = Canada national drink with Clamato.
45ml vodka + Clamato + Worcestershire + Tabasco + salt rim. Build.
Clamato (clam + tomato juice) difference. More popular Canada than USA.
wiki.art.cocktails.penicillin-sam-ross.d: Penicillin invented Sam Ross Milk & Honey NYC 2005. Scotch + honey + ginger + lime. Modern classic.
wiki.art.cocktails.penicillin-sam-ross.h: Sam Ross Milk & Honey 2005. Recipe for 'cure for all ills' — penicillin metaphor.
wiki.art.cocktails.penicillin-sam-ross.r: 60ml blended Scotch + 22ml lemon + 22ml honey-ginger syrup. Shake. Float 7.5ml Islay smoky Scotch.
wiki.art.cocktails.penicillin-sam-ross.t: Signature Islay float (Laphroaig, Ardbeg) smoke. Key fresh honey-ginger syrup.
wiki.art.cocktails.paper-plane-recipe.de: Paper Plane invented Sam Ross for Toby Maloney Violet Hour Chicago 2007. Bourbon + Aperol + Amaro Meletti + lemon.
wiki.art.cocktails.paper-plane-recipe.hi: Sam Ross M&H 2007 for Toby Maloney. M.I.A. song 'Paper Planes' inspiration.
wiki.art.cocktails.paper-plane-recipe.re: 22ml bourbon + 22ml Aperol + 22ml Amaro Meletti + 22ml lemon. Equal parts. Shake. Coupe.
wiki.art.cocktails.paper-plane-recipe.ti: Equal parts perfect balance. Specific Amaro Meletti (no Nonino or others).
wiki.art.cocktails.gold-rush-cocktail.de: Gold Rush invented T.J. Siegal Milk & Honey NYC 2002. Bourbon + honey + lemon. Modern Sour template.
wiki.art.cocktails.gold-rush-cocktail.hi: T.J. Siegal M&H 2002. Sasha Petraske refinement. Modern simple classic.
wiki.art.cocktails.gold-rush-cocktail.re: 60ml bourbon + 22ml lemon + 22ml honey syrup. Shake. Coupe up.
wiki.art.cocktails.gold-rush-cocktail.ti: Honey syrup (1:1 honey + hot water). Balanced fruity bourbon.
wiki.art.cocktails.naked-and-famous.desc: Naked and Famous invented Joaquin Simó Death & Co NYC 2011. Mezcal + Yellow Chartreuse + Aperol + lime. Equal parts.
wiki.art.cocktails.naked-and-famous.hist: Joaquin Simó Death & Co 2011. Cross between Last Word + Paper Plane.
wiki.art.cocktails.naked-and-famous.reci: 22ml mezcal + 22ml Yellow Chartreuse + 22ml Aperol + 22ml lime. Shake. Coupe.
wiki.art.cocktails.naked-and-famous.tips: Equal parts. Perfect smoky-sweet-bitter-tart balance. Young mezcal joven.
wiki.art.cocktails.trinidad-sour.title: Trinidad Sour
wiki.art.cocktails.trinidad-sour.descrip: Trinidad Sour invented Giuseppe Gonzalez Clover Club Brooklyn 2009. 1.5oz Angostura as main ingredient — crazy.
wiki.art.cocktails.trinidad-sour.history: Giuseppe Gonzalez 2009. Reinvented bitters as main spirit, not modifier.
wiki.art.cocktails.trinidad-sour.recipe: 45ml Angostura + 22ml rye + 22ml lemon + 30ml orgeat. Shake. Coupe.
wiki.art.cocktails.trinidad-sour.tips: Signature Angostura as primary spirit (not dash). Key orgeat balance.
wiki.art.cocktails.jasmine-cocktail.desc: Jasmine cocktail invented Paul Harrington Townhouse Berkeley 1990s. Gin + Campari + lemon + Cointreau.
wiki.art.cocktails.jasmine-cocktail.hist: Paul Harrington 1990s. Jasmine flower color (rose pink).
wiki.art.cocktails.jasmine-cocktail.reci: 45ml gin + 7.5ml Campari + 22ml lemon + 15ml Cointreau. Shake. Coupe.
wiki.art.cocktails.jasmine-cocktail.tips: Signature rose pink color. Sweeter than typical Negroni.
wiki.art.cocktails.gin-basil-smash.title: Gin Basil Smash
wiki.art.cocktails.gin-basil-smash.descr: Gin Basil Smash invented Jörg Meyer Le Lion Hamburg 2008. Gin + basil + lemon + sugar.
wiki.art.cocktails.gin-basil-smash.histo: Jörg Meyer Hamburg 2008. 'Gin Pesto' nickname. Modern German classic.
wiki.art.cocktails.gin-basil-smash.recip: 60ml gin + 22ml lemon + 22ml simple + 12 basil leaves. Hard shake. Double strain. DOF cubed.
wiki.art.cocktails.gin-basil-smash.tips: Basil leaves bruise for oils. Double strain (no green leaves).
wiki.art.cocktails.tommy-s-margarita-vs-: Tommy's Margarita = Margarita WITHOUT Cointreau, with agave syrup. Julio Bermejo Tommy's SF 1990s.
Julio Bermejo Tommy's Restaurant SF 1990s. Modern agave-Margarita pioneer.
60ml tequila + 30ml lime + 15ml agave syrup. Shake. Rocks (no salt rim).
100% agave tequila only. Without Cointreau more pure tequila taste. Tommy's SF standard.
wiki.art.cocktails.margarita-history.des: Margarita disputed origin — Carlos 'Danny' Herrera 1938, Margarita Sames 1948, Daisy variation. Daisy = Margarita in Spanish.
wiki.art.cocktails.margarita-history.his: Multiple claims 1930s-1940s Mexico. Most likely evolution from Daisy (Brandy Daisy → Tequila Daisy → Margarita).
wiki.art.cocktails.margarita-history.rec: 60ml tequila + 30ml lime + 30ml Cointreau. Shake. Salt rim (optional). Coupe.
wiki.art.cocktails.margarita-history.tip: Standard Cointreau, no cheap triple sec. Fresh lime. Embury 8:3:2.
wiki.art.cocktails.margarita-tommy-s-ver: Tommy's Margarita = without Cointreau, with agave syrup. More pure tequila version for 100% agave.
Julio Bermejo Tommy's Restaurant SF 1990s. Modernized Margarita for 100% agave tequila.
60ml 100% agave tequila + 30ml lime + 15ml agave syrup (1:1 agave nectar:water). Shake.
100% agave tequila essential. Modern bartenders' preferred version.
